qe: Which physical process characterizes the operational behavior of an electrochemical cell (Galvanic cell)?
qh: इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल सेल (गैल्वेनिक सेल) के परिचालन व्यवहार की क्या विशेषता है?
o: It uses electrical energy to drive a non-spontaneous chemical change
It converts the chemical energy of a spontaneous redox reaction into electrical energy (रासायनिक ऊर्जा को विद्युत ऊर्जा में बदलना)
It forces the system to reach structural absolute zero within hours
It utilizes external pressurized gas streams to synthesize polyolefins
e: Explanation: An electrochemical or Galvanic cell operates by harvesting the chemical energy released during a spontaneous redox reaction, converting it directly into electrical current.

qe: When an electricity stream is forced through an electrolytic cell to carry out a non-spontaneous chemical breakdown, what is the process called?
qh: जब किसी गैर-स्वतः रासायनिक अपघटन को पूरा करने के लिए एक इलेक्ट्रोलाइटिक सेल के माध्यम से विद्युत धारा को प्रवाहित किया जाता है, तो इस प्रक्रिया को क्या कहा जाता है?
o: Saponification of long-chain fatty esters
Electroluminescence grid illumination
Electrolysis (विद्युत अपघटन / इलेक्ट्रोलेसिस)
Ring-opening condensation polymerization
e: Explanation: Electrolysis is the phenomenon where electrical energy passed into an electrolytic cell drives a non-spontaneous chemical reaction, breaking down raw compounds into elements.

qe: What surprising origin characterizes the rapid transmission of sensory signals traveling from biological cells to the human brain?
qh: जैविक कोशिकाओं से मानव मस्तिष्क तक यात्रा करने वाले संवेदी संकेतों (sensory signals) के तीव्र संचरण की क्या विशेषता है?
o: A volatile open-chain ester vaporization route
An electrochemical origin (इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल मूल / ओरिजिन)
A completely thermal non-polar coordination matrix
A cross-linked dynamic mechanical polymer mechanism
e: Explanation: Cellular communication and the propagation of sensory impulses to the human brain are deeply governed by ionic movement and potential differences, establishing an electrochemical origin.

qe: When a generic metal piece is dipped into an aqueous solution containing its own ions, a potential separation barrier develops. What description explains this dynamic occurrence?
qh: जब एक धातु के टुकड़े को उसके अपने आयनों वाले जलीय घोल में डुबोया जाता है, तो एक संभावित पृथक्करण बाधा (potential separation barrier) विकसित होती है। कौन सा विवरण इस घटना को समझाता है?
o: The metal undergoes complete denaturing into volatile gases
An equilibrium sets up between the metal's tendency to dissolve as ions and the ions' tendency to deposit as metal atoms (साम्यावस्था स्थापित होना)
The solution initiates immediate common-ion precipitation of all materials
The framework generates an irreversible three-dimensional Bakelite network
e: Explanation: Immersing a metal electrode into its own ionic solution establishes a competitive charge separation interface. An equilibrium is reached between metal atoms leaving electrons behind to enter the solution and solution cations gaining electrons to deposit as metal.

qe: What structural component is mandatory to establish internal electrical connectivity and maintain neutral ion pools between two separate half-cell compartments?
qh: दो अलग-अलग हाफ-सेल डिब्बों के बीच आंतरिक विद्युत कनेक्टिविटी स्थापित करने और तटस्थ आयन पूल बनाए रखने के लिए कौन सा संरचनात्मक घटक अनिवार्य है?
o: A thick platinum-coated macro-wire filament
A Salt Bridge containing an inert electrolyte gel (लवण सेतु / साल्ट ब्रिज)
A porous linear non-ionic polyolefin shield
A volatile organic solvent buffer layer
e: Explanation: A salt bridge (typically an inverted U-tube filled with an inert electrolyte like $KCl$ in agar-agar gel) completes the internal circuit of a Galvanic cell and maintains electrical neutrality across both half-cells.

qe: What are the two primary operational tasks handled by a salt bridge inside a functioning Galvanic cell configuration?
qh: एक चालू गैल्वेनिक सेल कॉन्फ़िगरेशन के भीतर लवण सेतु (salt bridge) द्वारा नियंत्रित दो प्राथमिक परिचालन कार्य क्या हैं?
o: To insulate the electrodes and stop electron flow completely
To complete the internal circuit and maintain electrical neutrality across both solutions (सर्किट पूरा करना एवं विद्युत तटस्थता बनाए रखना)
To oxidize zinc into open-chain saccharic acid variations
To establish a positive quaternary nitrogen coordination zone
e: Explanation: The twin tasks of a salt bridge are completing the internal electrical circuit by facilitating counter-ion migration and maintaining overall solution neutrality as redox reactions progress.

qe: Which specific terminology designates the half-cell compartment inside an electrochemical setup where oxidation occurs?
qh: एक इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल सेटअप के भीतर किस विशिष्ट शब्दावली से उस हाफ-सेल कम्पार्टमेंट को नामित किया जाता है जहाँ ऑक्सीकरण (oxidation) होता है?
o: Cathode
Anode (एनोड)
Oligomeric reservoir
Volatile gas vent
e: Explanation: By universal electrochemical convention, the electrode where the oxidation half-reaction takes place is strictly defined as the anode.

qe: Which functional chemical event is exclusive to the cathode compartment of a functioning electrochemical cell?
qh: एक चालू इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल सेल के कैथोड कम्पार्टमेंट के लिए कौन सी कार्यात्मक रासायनिक घटना विशिष्ट है?
o: The continuous loss of electrons and oxidation of metal atoms
The chemical reduction half-reaction where cations accept electrons (अपचयन या रिडक्शन)
The cross-linking of linear intermediate Novolac resins
The conversion of water into fuming sulfuric acid segments
e: Explanation: The cathode is explicitly defined as the electrode domain where chemical reduction occurs, meaning migratory cations capture passing electrons to plate out or drop valence states.

qe: What charge sign configuration characterizes the anode and cathode domains respectively inside a functioning Galvanic cell?
qh: एक चालू गैल्वेनिक सेल के भीतर एनोड और कैथोड डोमेन की क्रमशः क्या चार्ज साइन कॉन्फ़िगरेशन विशेषता है?
o: Anode is positive, Cathode is negative
Anode is negative, Cathode is positive (एनोड ऋणात्मक तथा कैथोड धनात्मक)
Both maintain a shared absolute zero electrical neutral state
Both turn highly basic with a pH tracking toward 14
e: Explanation: In a Galvanic (voltaic) cell, oxidation releases electrons at the anode, making it the negative terminal. Cations consume electrons at the cathode, making it the positive terminal.

qe: What physical consequence occurs in a classic Danell cell system if the applied external opposing voltage ($E_{ext}$) is perfectly balanced at 1.1 V?
qh: एक क्लासिक डेनियल सेल सिस्टम में क्या भौतिक परिणाम होता है यदि लागू बाहरी विरोधी वोल्टेज ($E_{ext}$) पूरी तरह से 1.1 V पर संतुलित हो?
o: Electron flow accelerates from the copper electrode toward zinc blocks
No net current or electrons flow through the cell, halting all chemical changes (कोई विद्युत धारा प्रवाहित नहीं होती)
The cell undergoes spontaneous explosion due to internal heating parameters
The electrolyte gel inside the salt bridge precipitates completely
e: Explanation: A standard Daniell cell delivers a cell potential of 1.1 V. If an external counter-voltage matches this value exactly ($E_{ext} = 1.1\text{ V}$), the opposing forces balance, halting all electron flow and chemical reaction steps.

qe: If the external opposing voltage applied to a Daniell cell exceeds the cell's native potential ($E_{ext} > 1.1\text{ V}$), what operational shift occurs?
qh: यदि डेनियल सेल पर लागू बाहरी विरोधी वोल्टेज सेल के मूल वोल्टेज से अधिक हो जाता है ($E_{ext} > 1.1\text{ V}$), तो क्या परिचालन परिवर्तन होता है?
o: The cell circuit melts due to coordinate ionic resistance constraints
The cell functions as an electrolytic cell, reversing the direction of chemical reactions and electron flow (इलेक्ट्रोलाइटिक सेल की तरह कार्य करना)
The system transitions into a biodegradable sugar acid configuration
The zinc electrode starts to dissolve at ten times its normal speed
e: Explanation: When $E_{ext} > 1.1\text{ V}$, the external electrical energy forces the cell to operate in reverse. It transitions into an electrolytic cell where electrons are driven from copper to zinc, reversing the native chemical reactions.

qe: What potential difference parameter defines the potential profile of a half-cell when all ion concentrations are unity and gases are at 1 bar pressure?
qh: कौन सा संभावित अंतर पैरामीटर (potential difference parameter) एक हाफ-सेल के संभावित प्रोफाइल को परिभाषित करता है जब सभी आयन सांद्रता इकाई हो और गैसें 1 बार दबाव पर हों?
o: Oligomeric asymmetric potential
Standard Electrode Potential (मानक इलेक्ट्रोड विभव)
Unbranched non-ionic volatile resistance
Irreversible cross-linked network coefficient
e: Explanation: When all participating chemical species are at their standard states (1 mol/L concentration for ions, 1 bar pressure for gases, pure solids/liquids), the measured potential is termed the Standard Electrode Potential ($E^\circ$).

qe: What formal definition distinguishes the Electromotive Force (EMF) of a cell from its standard cell potential profile?
qh: कौन सी औपचारिक परिभाषा किसी सेल के इलेक्ट्रोमोटिव फोर्स (EMF) को उसके मानक सेल विभव प्रोफाइल से अलग करती है?
o: EMF represents the maximum resistance offered by the salt bridge matrix
EMF is the potential difference between two electrodes when no current is drawn through the cell (जब कोई धारा प्रवाहित न हो रही हो)
EMF measures the absolute rate of nitrogen gas generation at the cathode
EMF is an extensive property that scales directly with the size of electrodes
e: Explanation: The cell potential is termed the Electromotive Force (EMF) specifically when the electrical circuit is open, meaning no net electrical current is being drawn from the cell assembly.

qe: By international convention, what type of electrode potential is standard state data always reported as across the electrochemical series?
qh: अंतरराष्ट्रीय सम्मेलन द्वारा, इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल श्रृंखला में मानक स्थिति डेटा को हमेशा किस प्रकार के इलेक्ट्रोड विभव के रूप में सूचित किया जाता है?
o: Standard Oxidation Potential values
Standard Reduction Potential values (मानक अपचयन विभव)
Standard Cationic Volatility indices
Standard Cross-linked Amide link densities
e: Explanation: According to IUPAC conventions, standard electrode potentials are strictly reported and tabulated as Standard Reduction Potentials ($E^\circ_{red}$).

qe: How does multiplying a half-cell reaction equation by a stoichiometric coefficient (e.g., doubling the coefficients) alter its standard electrode potential ($E^\circ$)?
qh: किसी हाफ-सेल प्रतिक्रिया समीकरण को स्टोइकोमेट्रिक गुणांक से गुणा करने पर (जैसे गुणांक को दोगुना करने पर) उसके मानक इलेक्ट्रोड विभव ($E^\circ$) में क्या परिवर्तन होता है?
o: The value of $E^\circ$ doubles immediately due to mass action laws
The value of $E^\circ$ remains completely unchanged because potential is an intensive property (अपरिवर्तित रहना / intensive गुण)
The value of $E^\circ$ drops to its absolute inverse configuration
The value of $E^\circ$ converts into a volatile logarithmic value
e: Explanation: Electrode potential is an intensive property, meaning it is independent of the amount of substance reacting. Scaling a half-reaction with a stoichiometric coefficient does not change its $E^\circ$ value.

qe: Why is it physically impossible to measure the absolute electrode potential profile of an isolated individual half-cell directly?
qh: किसी पृथक व्यक्तिगत हाफ-सेल के पूर्ण इलेक्ट्रोड विभव प्रोफाइल को सीधे मापना भौतिक रूप से असंभव क्यों है?
o: Because half-cells turn completely volatile when isolated from air boundaries
Because a chemical oxidation or reduction half-reaction cannot take place independently without a complementary counter-reaction (अकेले हाफ-सेल में कोई अभिक्रिया नहीं हो सकती)
Because it requires the complete removal of all oxygen groups from the solution
Because it causes the immediate common-ion precipitation of all ionic reagents
e: Explanation: A single half-cell cannot undergo a net chemical oxidation or reduction independently. A redox process requires a complete circuit connecting two half-cells, meaning only relative potential differences can be measured.

qe: What reference standard electrode configuration has been assigned an arbitrary potential value of exactly zero volts across all temperatures?
qh: किस संदर्भ मानक इलेक्ट्रोड कॉन्फ़िगरेशन को सभी तापमानों पर बिल्कुल शून्य वोल्ट का एक मनमाना संभावित मान (arbitrary potential value) सौंपा गया है?
o: The copper-copper sulfate half-cell system
The Standard Hydrogen Electrode (SHE / शी इलेक्ट्रोड - 0 V)
The linear unbranched dicarboxylic acid framework
The heavily branched cross-linked zinc resin lattice
e: Explanation: To calibrate relative potentials, the Standard Hydrogen Electrode (SHE), consisting of platinum black immersed in a 1 M $H^+$ solution with $H_2$ gas at 1 bar, is assigned an arbitrary standard potential of $0.00\text{ V}$ at all temperatures.

qe: What structural role does the chemically inert platinum wire or foil assume inside a standard gas-ion half-cell configuration like the SHE?
qh: शी (SHE) जैसे मानक गैस-आयन हाफ-सेल कॉन्फ़िगरेशन के भीतर रासायनिक रूप से निष्क्रिय प्लैटिनम तार या फ़ॉइल क्या संरचनात्मक भूमिका निभाते हैं?
o: It dissolves into the acid to provide additional metal cations
It provides an inert surface for electron transfer and facilitates gas adsorption without reacting (इलेक्ट्रॉन ट्रांसफर के लिए सतह प्रदान करना)
It converts passing hydronium ions into open-chain saccharic acids
It acts as a primary free-radical peroxide catalyst system
e: Explanation: Platinum is chemically inert and does not participate in the redox chemistry. It serves as an unreactive conductor that provides a surface layer for electron exchange and hydrogen gas adsorption.

qe: When evaluating values across the electrochemical series, what does a large positive value for a standard reduction potential indicate about a chemical species?
qh: इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल श्रृंखला के मानों का मूल्यांकन करते समय, किसी रासायनिक प्रजाति के लिए मानक अपचयन विभव (standard reduction potential) का एक बड़ा धनात्मक मान क्या दर्शाता है?
o: The species is highly volatile and boils away rapidly under low pressures
The species has a strong tendency to undergo reduction, making it a powerful oxidizing agent (मजबूत ऑक्सीकरण एजेंट होना)
The species functions as a non-competitive irreversible suicide inhibitor
The species lacks carbon atoms completely inside its organic matrix
e: Explanation: A large positive reduction potential ($E^\circ$) indicates that a chemical species is easily reduced. It acts as a powerful electron acceptor or strong oxidizing agent (e.g., Fluorine gas, $F_2$).

qe: Which specific chemical species occupies the extreme baseline position of the standard electrochemical series, acting as the strongest reducing agent?
qh: कौन सी विशिष्ट रासायनिक प्रजाति मानक इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल श्रृंखला के चरम आधार स्थान पर है, जो सबसे मजबूत अपचायक (strongest reducing agent) के रूप में कार्य करती है?
o: Fluorine gas ($F_2$)
Lithium metal ($Li$ - लिथियम धातु)
Copper sheet fractions
Aqueous hydrochloric acid
e: Explanation: Lithium metal ($Li$) exhibits a large negative standard reduction potential. This indicates an extreme resistance to reduction and a strong tendency to undergo oxidation, making it the strongest reducing agent in the series.

qe: What mathematical relationship allows electrochemists to calculate cell potentials under non-standard ion concentrations?
qh: कौन सा गणितीय संबंध इलेक्ट्रोकेमिस्ट को गैर-मानक आयन सांद्रता के तहत सेल क्षमता की गणना करने की अनुमति देता है?
o: The Ostwald dilution expression
The Nernst Equation (नर्स्ट समीकरण)
The Novolac cross-linking matrix loop
The free-radical addition polymer equation
e: Explanation: The Nernst equation correlates the electrode potential of a half-cell or full cell structure to the standard potential ($E^\circ$), temperature ($T$), and the activities or concentrations of the reacting chemical species.

qe: What simplified constant value replaces the term $\frac{2.303 RT}{F}$ inside the Nernst equation when an electrochemical reaction is run precisely at 298 K?
qh: जब एक इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल प्रतिक्रिया बिल्कुल 298 K पर चलाई जाती है तो नर्स्ट समीकरण के भीतर पद $\frac{2.303 RT}{F}$ को कौन सा सरलीकृत स्थिरांक मान प्रतिस्थापित करता है?
o: 96500 absolute Faradays
1.10 Volts exactly
8.314 Real Joules
e: Explanation: Substituting standard values ($R = 8.314\text{ J/mol}\cdot\text{K}$, $T = 298\text{ K}$, and $F = 96487\text{ C/mol}$) into the Nernst factor $\frac{2.303 RT}{F}$ simplifies the term to $0.0591\text{ V}$.

qe: What physical status defines the potential profile of a Galvanic cell when its reacting system has reached chemical equilibrium?
qh: एक गैल्वेनिक सेल के संभावित प्रोफाइल को कौन सी भौतिक स्थिति परिभाषित करती है जब उसकी प्रतिक्रिया प्रणाली रासायनिक संतुलन (chemical equilibrium) तक पहुँच जाती है?
o: The cell potential ($E_{cell}$) drops to exactly zero volts (E_cell का मान शून्य होना)
The standard potential ($E^\circ_{cell}$) drops to exactly zero volts
The cell undergoes immediate reverse ring-opening cleavage
The internal resistance drops down to zero net ohms
e: Explanation: At chemical equilibrium, the forward and reverse reaction velocities match exactly. No net electrical work can be extracted, meaning the dynamic cell potential ($E_{cell}$) drops to $0\text{ V}$, though the standard potential ($E^\circ_{cell}$) remains unaffected.

qe: Which specific equation correctly links the standard cell potential ($E^\circ_{cell}$) directly to the equilibrium constant ($K_C$) at 298 K?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट समीकरण 298 K पर मानक सेल विभव ($E^\circ_{cell}$) को सीधे संतुलन स्थिरांक ($K_C$) से जोड़ता है?
o: $E^\circ_{cell} = -nF \log K_C$
$E^\circ_{cell} = \frac{0.059}{n} \log K_C$ (समीकरण रूप)
$E^\circ_{cell} = 1.11 \times n \log K_C$
$E^\circ_{cell} = \Delta G^\circ \log K_C$
e: Explanation: Setting $E_{cell} = 0\text{ V}$ at equilibrium in the Nernst equation allows it to be rearranged into the standard relationship at 298 K: $E^\circ_{cell} = \frac{0.059}{n} \log K_C$.

qe: What thermodynamic parameter defines the maximum electrical work that can be extracted from an electrochemical cell operating reversibly?
qh: कौन सा ऊष्मागतिक पैरामीटर (thermodynamic parameter) एक प्रतिवर्ती रूप से काम करने वाले इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल सेल से निकाली जा सकने वाली अधिकतम विद्युत कार्य को परिभाषित करता है?
o: The total entropy shift of the surrounding buffer
The change in standard Gibbs Free Energy (\Delta G / गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा में परिवर्तन)
The change in the internal resistance profile
The total heat capacity value under pressure
e: Explanation: Cationic and anionic flux driven reversibly within a cell yields electrical work. This maximum usable work corresponds to the drop in the system's Gibbs Free Energy ($\\Delta G$).

qe: Which mathematical expression correctly defines the standard Gibbs free energy change ($\Delta G^\circ$) in terms of standard cell potential?
qh: कौन सा गणितीय व्यंजक मानक सेल विभव के संदर्भ में मानक गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा परिवर्तन ($\Delta G^\circ$) को सही ढंग से परिभाषित करता है?
o: $\Delta G^\circ = -nF E^\circ_{cell}$ (ऊर्जा समीकरण रूप)
$\Delta G^\circ = \frac{E^\circ_{cell}}{nF}$
$\Delta G^\circ = -RT \log E^\circ_{cell}$
$\Delta G^\circ = nF \log K_C$
e: Explanation: The maximum standard electrical work equals the drop in standard Gibbs Free Energy, defined mathematically by the foundational equation: $\Delta G^\circ = -nF E^\circ_{cell}$.

qe: What is the formal physical definition of one Faraday ($F$) of electrical charge in quantitative electrochemistry?
qh: मात्रात्मक इलेक्ट्रोकेमिस्ट्री में विद्युत आवेश के एक फैराडे ($F$) की औपचारिक भौतिक परिभाषा क्या है?
o: The absolute electrical resistance of a one-meter copper wire filament
The total electrical charge carried by exactly one mole of electrons (एक मोल इलेक्ट्रॉनों का कुल आवेश)
The potential difference developed across a standard pyranose ring
The free-radical propagation rate under absolute zero conditions
e: Explanation: One Faraday ($F$) represents the total magnitude of electrical charge contained on one mole ($6.022 \times 10^{23}$) of electrons, which rounds to approximately $96500\text{ C/mol}$.

qe: What must the sign profile of a cell potential ($E_{cell}$) and a Gibbs free energy change ($\Delta G$) be for a redox reaction to be classified as spontaneous?
qh: किसी रेडॉक्स प्रतिक्रिया को स्वतः (spontaneous) वर्गीकृत करने के लिए सेल विभव ($E_{cell}$) और गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा परिवर्तन ($\Delta G$) का साइन प्रोफाइल क्या होना चाहिए?
o: $E_{cell}$ must be negative, and $\Delta G$ must be positive
$E_{cell}$ must be positive, and $\Delta G$ must be negative (E_cell धनात्मक तथा \Delta G ऋणात्मक)
Both must maintain identical positive charge states simultaneously
Both must drop to zero absolute neutral indicators
e: Explanation: Thermodynamically, spontaneous processes require a negative Gibbs Free Energy change ($\Delta G < 0$). According to the equation $\Delta G = -nFE_{cell}$, this requirement is met only when the cell potential is positive ($E_{cell} > 0$).

qe: How does the mathematical value of a cell's standard standard potential ($E^\circ_{cell}$) behave when classified under intensive versus extensive physical properties?
qh: किसी सेल के मानक विभव ($E^\circ_{cell}$) का गणितीय मान गहन (intensive) बनाम व्यापक (extensive) भौतिक गुणों के तहत वर्गीकृत होने पर कैसा व्यवहार करता है?
o: It is extensive because it scales directly with the volume of solution
It is intensive because it does not depend on the amount of material or stoichiometric scaling (intensive गुण)
It is a volatile non-polar extensive parameter driven by pressure
It transforms into an extensive property when cross-linked via amides
e: Explanation: Standard cell potential ($E^\circ_{cell}$) is an intensive property because its value depends solely on the chemical identity of the redox couples, not the total mass or stoichiometric coefficients used in the reaction equation.

qe: In quantitative conductivity work, what inverse relationship defines the electrical conductance ($G$) of a material?
qh: मात्रात्मक चालकता कार्य में, कौन सा व्युत्क्रम संबंध (inverse relationship) किसी सामग्री के विद्युत चालन ($G$) को परिभाषित करता है?
o: It is the direct square root of the cross-linked link count
It is the mathematical reciprocal of electrical resistance ($G = 1/R$) (प्रतिरोध का व्युत्क्रम)
It is the inverse of the logarithmic equilibrium constant profile
It represents the total mass of metal deposited per second
e: Explanation: Conductance ($G$) represents the ease with which electrical current passes through a material. It is defined mathematically as the reciprocal of electrical resistance: $G = 1/R$, with units reported in Siemens ($S$) or $\Omega^{-1}$.

qe: What primary SI unit designation is universally utilized to report electrical conductance values?
qh: विद्युत चालन (conductance) मानों को सूचित करने के लिए कौन सा प्राथमिक SI इकाई पदनाम सार्वभौमिक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Ohm meters
Siemens ($S$ - सीमेंस)
Faraday per mole
Methylene amide units
e: Explanation: The SI unit for electrical conductance is the Siemens, represented by the symbol '$S$'. It is equivalent to $\Omega^{-1}$ or mho.

qe: What terminology defines the structural constant given by the ratio $\frac{\ell}{A}$ for a specific conductivity cell configuration?
qh: कौन सी शब्दावली एक विशिष्ट चालकता सेल कॉन्फ़िगरेशन के लिए अनुपात $\frac{\ell}{A}$ द्वारा दिए गए संरचनात्मक स्थिरांक को परिभाषित करती है?
o: Molar conductance factor
Cell Constant ($G^*$ / सेल स्थिरांक)
Adsorption coordination index
Linear tactical expansion constant
e: Explanation: The cell constant ($G^*$) represents the geometric ratio of the distance between the cell's electrodes ($\ell$) to their cross-sectional area ($A$). It remains fixed for a specific conductivity cell setup.

qe: How is the cell constant ($G^*$) typically calculated in a laboratory configuration using a known reference electrolyte solution?
qh: एक ज्ञात संदर्भ इलेक्ट्रोलाइट समाधान का उपयोग करके प्रयोगशाला कॉन्फ़िगरेशन में सेल स्थिरांक ($G^*$) की गणना आमतौर पर कैसे की जाती है?
o: By distilling the solution into volatile petroleum fragments
By multiplying the measured resistance ($R$) by the known conductivity ($\kappa$) of the reference solution ($G^* = \kappa \cdot R$) (चालकता एवं प्रतिरोध का गुणनफल)
By calculating the exact thickness of the platinum coating layer
By measuring the total volume of gas evolved per minute
e: Explanation: Because measuring physical electrode dimensions directly is difficult, the cell constant ($G^*$) is determined by measuring the resistance ($R$) of a standard solution (usually $KCl$) of known conductivity ($\kappa$): $G^* = \kappa \cdot R$.

qe: What formal name is assigned to the conductivity parameter defined as the conductance of a one-centimeter cube of an electrolyte solution?
qh: उस चालकता पैरामीटर को क्या औपचारिक नाम दिया गया है जिसे इलेक्ट्रोलाइट समाधान के एक सेंटीमीटर क्यूब के चालन के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है?
o: Molar conductance
Conductivity or Specific Conductance (\kappa / चालकता)
Standard state EMF profile
Elastomeric cross-linked density
e: Explanation: Conductivity (specific conductance, represented by $\kappa$) is defined as the conductance of a solution enclosed within an area of a $1\text{ cm}^2$ cross-section separated by a distance of $1\text{ cm}$ ($1\text{ cm}^3$ volume block).

qe: What is the core mathematical formula used to calculate the Molar Conductivity ($\Lambda_m$) of a solution from its specific conductivity ($\kappa$) and molarity ($M$) in standard laboratory units?
qh: मानक प्रयोगशाला इकाइयों में समाधान की विशिष्ट चालकता ($\kappa$) और मोलरिटी ($M$) से उसकी मोलर चालकता ($\Lambda_m$) की गणना करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला मुख्य गणितीय सूत्र क्या है?
o: $\Lambda_m = \frac{M \cdot \kappa}{1000}$
$\Lambda_m = \frac{1000 \cdot \kappa}{M}$ (मोलर चालकता सूत्र)
$\Lambda_m = \kappa \cdot G^*$
$\Lambda_m = \frac{\kappa \cdot R}{M}$
e: Explanation: When conductivity $\kappa$ is measured in $\text{S}\cdot\text{cm}^{-1}$ and concentration $M$ is in $\text{mol/L}$, the molar conductivity is calculated using the formula: $\Lambda_m = \frac{1000 \cdot \kappa}{M}$.

qe: What structural feature accounts for the metallic conduction seen in transition metals, differentiating it from the conductivity profile of electrolyte solutions?
qh: संक्रमण धातुओं में देखी जाने वाली धात्विक चालन (metallic conduction) के लिए कौन सी संरचनात्मक विशेषता जिम्मेदार है, जो इसे इलेक्ट्रोलाइट समाधानों की चालकता प्रोफ़ाइल से अलग करती है?
o: The rapid migration of hydrated mineral anions
The free movement of valence electrons through the metal lattice matrix (मुक्त इलेक्ट्रॉनों का प्रवाह)
The complete conversion of atoms into uncharged non-ionic polyols
The presence of flexible disulfide links across domains
e: Explanation: Metallic (electronic) conduction relies on the fluid movement of valence electrons through a continuous lattice under an applied electric field, proceeding without any chemical decomposition of the metal material.

qe: How does increasing the system operational temperature typically alter the electrical conductivity profile of metallic conductors?
qh: प्रणाली के परिचालन तापमान को बढ़ाने से आमतौर पर धात्विक चालकों (metallic conductors) के विद्युत चालकता प्रोफ़ाइल में क्या परिवर्तन होता है?
o: The conductivity increases exponentially due to ion generation
The conductivity decreases because increased thermal vibrations scatter electron paths (तापमान बढ़ने पर धात्विक चालकता का घटना)
The conductivity drops instantly to absolute zero via structural charring
The standard potential switches signs from positive to negative
e: Explanation: Raising the temperature increases lattice vibrations (thermal scattering of electrons) inside a metallic conductor. This creates higher resistance, which causes the electrical conductivity of the metal to decrease.

qe: What happens to the relative conductivity profile of an electrolytic solution when its ambient temperature is systematically raised?
qh: जब एक इलेक्ट्रोलाइटिक समाधान के परिवेशी तापमान को व्यवस्थित रूप से बढ़ाया जाता है तो उसकी सापेक्ष चालकता प्रोफ़ाइल (conductivity profile) का क्या होता है?
o: The conductivity decreases because ions freeze into linear oligomers
The conductivity increases because ion mobility increases and inter-ionic friction drops (तापमान बढ़ने पर आयनिक चालकता का बढ़ना)
The conductivity drops to zero via common-ion precipitation
The solution converts into a rigid cross-linked polymer layer
e: Explanation: In electrolytic solutions, higher temperatures reduce viscosity and inter-ionic attractions while increasing kinetic energy. This enhances ion mobility, causing the electrolytic conductivity to increase.

qe: What physical consequence occurs to the value of specific conductivity ($\kappa$) when an electrolyte solution undergoes heavy dilution?
qh: जब एक इलेक्ट्रोलाइट समाधान भारी तनुकरण (heavy dilution) से गुजरता है तो विशिष्ट चालकता ($\kappa$) के मान पर क्या भौतिक परिणाम होता है?
o: The value of $\kappa$ increases because the volume expands cleanly
The value of $\kappa$ decreases because the number of current-carrying ions per unit volume drops (तनुकरण करने पर विशिष्ट चालकता का घटना)
The value of $\kappa$ is locked permanently at a constant index
The value of $\kappa$ doubles via spontaneous free-radical propagation
e: Explanation: Specific conductivity ($\kappa$) measures current-carrying capacity per unit volume. Diluting a solution increases the total volume, which decreases the total number of ions present per unit volume, causing $\kappa$ to fall.

qe: How does the molar conductivity ($\Lambda_m$) of both strong and weak electrolytes react when a solution is subjected to progressive dilution?
qh: जब किसी समाधान को प्रगतिशील तनुकरण (progressive dilution) के अधीन किया जाता है तो मजबूत और कमजोर दोनों इलेक्ट्रोलाइट्स की मोलर चालकता ($\Lambda_m$) कैसे प्रतिक्रिया करती है?
o: The value of $\Lambda_m$ decreases due to spatial volume constraints
The value of $\Lambda_m$ increases because the volume enclosing one mole of electrolyte expands, overcoming the drop in specific conductivity (तनुकरण करने पर मोलर चालकता का बढ़ना)
The value of $\Lambda_m$ drops to exactly zero at all concentration metrics
The value of $\Lambda_m$ undergoes conversion into a volatile dicarboxylic acid form
e: Explanation: Molar conductivity is defined by $\Lambda_m = \frac{\kappa}{C}$. As a solution is diluted, the concentration ($C$) drops rapidly. This factor outweighs the decrease in specific conductivity ($\kappa$), causing $\Lambda_m$ to increase for both strong and weak electrolytes.

qe: What specific linear relationship details the variation of molar conductivity alongside square root concentration for a strong electrolyte?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट रैखिक संबंध (linear relationship) एक मजबूत इलेक्ट्रोलाइट के लिए वर्गमूल सांद्रता के साथ मोलर चालकता के परिवर्तन का विवरण देता है?
o: The Ostwald dilution expression
The Debye-Huckel-Onsager Equation (डिबाई-हकल-ऑन्सेगर समीकरण)
The Haworth projections structural blueprint
The free-radical chain terminator step
e: Explanation: For strong electrolytes, the linear increase of molar conductivity at low concentrations follows the Debye-Huckel-Onsager relationship: $\Lambda_m = \Lambda_m^\circ - A\sqrt{C}$.

qe: What architectural term defines the maximum bounding value of molar conductivity achieved when the concentration of an electrolyte approaches exactly zero?
qh: पॉलिमर या इलेक्ट्रोलाइट रसायन विज्ञान में, जब किसी इलेक्ट्रोलाइट की सांद्रता बिल्कुल शून्य के करीब पहुँचती है तो प्राप्त मोलर चालकता के अधिकतम सीमा मान को कौन सा संरचनात्मक शब्द परिभाषित करता है?
o: Anomeric intermediate potential
Limiting Molar Conductivity (अनंत तनुता पर मोलर चालकता - \Lambda_m^\circ)
Unbranched non-ionic resistance matrix
Cross-linked network conductivity index
e: Explanation: When dilution is carried out to an infinite degree and concentration approaches zero, the molar conductivity reaches a maximum limiting value termed the Limiting Molar Conductivity ($\Lambda_m^\circ$).

qe: Why can the limiting molar conductivity ($\Lambda_m^\circ$) of a weak electrolyte like acetic acid not be determined directly via extrapolation of a standard concentration plot?
qh: एसिटिक एसिड जैसे कमजोर इलेक्ट्रोलाइट की सीमित मोलर चालकता ($\Lambda_m^\circ$) को मानक सांद्रता प्लॉट के बहिर्वेशन (extrapolation) के माध्यम से सीधे क्यों निर्धारित नहीं किया जा सकता है?
o: Because weak electrolytes decompose into volatile chlorine gas segments
Because the plot curves sharply upward nearly parallel to the axis at low concentrations, preventing an intercept touch (ग्राफ का समानांतर होना)
Because it requires the addition of high concentrations of sulfur builders
Because the primary alcohol undergoes conversion into an aromatic ring
e: Explanation: For weak electrolytes, dilution causes a sharp upward curve in $\Lambda_m$ at low concentrations due to a surge in ionization. The plot runs nearly parallel to the y-axis, making it impossible to extrapolate an intercept value directly.

qe: What operational law states that the limiting molar conductivity of an electrolyte can be calculated as the sum of the individual contributions of its anions and cations?
qh: कौन सा परिचालन नियम यह बताता है कि किसी इलेक्ट्रोलाइट की सीमित मोलर चालकता की गणना उसके अनियनों और कटायनों के व्यक्तिगत योगदान के योग के रूप में की जा सकती है?
o: The Ostwald dilution guideline
Kohlrausch's Law of Independent Migration of Ions (कोलराउश का नियम)
The Gibbs free energy balance equation
The Faraday quantitative electrochemistry rule
e: Explanation: Kohlrausch's Law states that at infinite dilution, where ions are completely separated, each ion migrates independently and contributes a fixed amount to the total limiting molar conductivity, regardless of the nature of the co-ion.

qe: What is the correct mathematical expression used to calculate the degree of dissociation ($\alpha$) of a weak electrolyte from its molar conductivity values?
qh: अमीनो एसिड या इलेक्ट्रोलाइट मानों से कमजोर इलेक्ट्रोलाइट के विघटन की डिग्री ($\alpha$) की गणना करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला सही गणितीय व्यंजक क्या है?
o: $\alpha = \Lambda_m \cdot \Lambda_m^\circ$
$\alpha = \frac{\Lambda_m}{\Lambda_m^\circ}$ (विघटन की डिग्री सूत्र)
$\alpha = \frac{\kappa \cdot 1000}{M}$
$\alpha = nF E^\circ_{cell}$
e: Explanation: The degree of dissociation ($\alpha$) of a weak electrolyte at a specific concentration is calculated as the ratio of its molar conductivity ($\Lambda_m$) to its limiting molar conductivity ($\Lambda_m^\circ$): $\alpha = \frac{\Lambda_m}{\Lambda_m^\circ}$.

qe: What quantitative chemical relationship governs the mass of a substance deposited or liberated at an electrode during electrolysis?
qh: इलेक्ट्रोलेसिस के दौरान इलेक्ट्रोड पर जमा या मुक्त होने वाले पदार्थ के द्रव्यमान को कौन सा मात्रात्मक रासायनिक संबंध नियंत्रित करता है?
o: The Nernst equilibrium relationship
Faraday's Laws of Electrolysis (फैराडे के विद्युत अपघटन के नियम)
The Debye-Huckel linear chain projection
The Kohrausch ionic alignment grid
e: Explanation: Quantitative mass conversions during electrolysis are governed by Faraday's Laws. The First Law states that the mass liberated is proportional to the total electrical charge passed through the cell configuration.

qe: According to Faraday's Second Law of Electrolysis, when the same quantity of electricity is passed through different solutions, the masses of liberated substances are proportional to what parameter?
qh: फैराडे के विद्युत अपघटन के दूसरे नियम के अनुसार, जब विभिन्न समाधानों के माध्यम से समान मात्रा में बिजली प्रवाहित की जाती है, तो मुक्त पदार्थों का द्रव्यमान किस पैरामीटर के समानुपाती होता है?
o: Their total volume profile in linear cubic meters
Their chemical equivalent weights (उनके रासायनिक तुल्यांकी भार के समानुपाती)
The total number of oxygen atoms inside their sugar rings
The cross-linking density of their structural amide bridges
e: Explanation: Faraday's Second Law states that passing identical amounts of electrical charge through different electrolytic cells deposits or liberates masses of substances in the exact ratio of their chemical equivalent weights ($M/n$ factor).

qe: What direct chemical reaction occurs at the cathode during the industrial electrolysis of a molten sodium chloride sample?
qh: पिघले हुए सोडियम क्लोराइड (molten NaCl) नमूने के औद्योगिक विद्युत अपघटन के दौरान कैथोड पर कौन सी विशिष्ट रासायनिक प्रतिक्रिया होती है?
o: Chlorine gas is generated via the loss of electrons
Sodium ions capture electrons to plate out as liquid sodium metal (सोडियम धातु का जमा होना)
Water molecules split into volatile open-chain non-polar gases
Cationic components form a permanent three-dimensional network
e: Explanation: Electrolyzing molten $NaCl$ involves no water molecules. Cations migrate to the negative terminal (cathode) where they pick up electrons and undergo reduction to yield liquid sodium metal: $Na^+ + e^- \rightarrow Na(l)$.

qe: When an aqueous solution of sodium chloride ($NaCl$) undergoes complete electrolysis, which specific gas is selectively liberated at the cathode terminal?
qh: जब सोडियम क्लोराइड ($NaCl$) का जलीय घोल पूर्ण विद्युत अपघटन से गुजरता है, तो कैथोड टर्मिनल पर कौन सी विशिष्ट गैस चुनिंदा रूप से मुक्त होती है?
o: Oxygen gas ($O_2$)
Hydrogen gas ($H_2$ - हाइड्रोजन गैस)
Chlorine gas ($Cl_2$)
Ammonia gas fumes
e: Explanation: In aqueous $NaCl$, both $Na^+$ and $H^+$ (from water) compete at the cathode. Because hydrogen ions undergo reduction more easily ($E^\circ = 0.00\text{ V}$) than sodium ions ($E^\circ = -2.71\text{ V}$), hydrogen gas ($H_2$) is liberated at the cathode terminal.

qe: Why is chlorine gas ($Cl_2$) selectively liberated at the anode during the electrolysis of aqueous $NaCl$, despite water having a lower thermodynamic potential requirement?
qh: जलीय $NaCl$ के विद्युत अपघटन के दौरान एनोड पर क्लोरीन गैस ($Cl_2$) को चुनिंदा रूप से क्यों मुक्त किया जाता है, इसके बावजूद कि पानी में कम ऊष्मागतिकी क्षमता की आवश्यकता होती है?
o: Because chlorine atoms are completely insoluble in aqueous mediums
Due to the kinetic phenomenon of overvoltage, which makes water oxidation slow and difficult (ओवर-पोटेंशियल या ओवर-वोल्टेज के कारण)
Because it requires the addition of high concentrations of sulfur builders
Because the primary alcohol undergoes conversion into an aromatic ring
e: Explanation: Thermodynamically, water oxidation to $O_2$ requires less potential ($1.23\text{ V}$) than chloride oxidation to $Cl_2$ ($1.36\text{ V}$). However, water oxidation is kinetically slow and requires an extra potential known as overvoltage, making chloride oxidation more favorable in practice.

qe: Which specific configuration of an electrochemical cell will accurately measure the standard electrode potential of a copper electrode ($E^\circ_{\text{Cu}^{2+}/\text{Cu}}$)?
qh: इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल सेल का कौन सा विशिष्ट विन्यास कॉपर इलेक्ट्रोड के मानक इलेक्ट्रोड विभव ($E^\circ_{\text{Cu}^{2+}/\text{Cu}}$) को सटीक रूप से मापेगा?
o: $\text{Pt}(s) \mid \text{H}_2(g, 0.1\text{ bar}) \mid \text{H}^+(aq, 1\text{ M}) \parallel \text{Cu}^{2+}(aq, 1\text{ M}) \mid \text{Cu}$
$\text{Pt}(s) \mid \text{H}_2(g, 1\text{ bar}) \mid \text{H}^+(aq, 1\text{ M}) \parallel \text{Cu}^{2+}(aq, 2\text{ M}) \mid \text{Cu}$
$\text{Pt}(s) \mid \text{H}_2(g, 1\text{ bar}) \mid \text{H}^+(aq, 1\text{ M}) \parallel \text{Cu}^{2+}(aq, 1\text{ M}) \mid \text{Cu}$
$\text{Pt}(s) \mid \text{H}_2(g, 0.1\text{ bar}) \mid \text{H}^+(aq, 0.1\text{ M}) \parallel \text{Cu}^{2+}(aq, 1\text{ M}) \mid \text{Cu}$
e: Explanation: To measure the standard electrode potential of a copper electrode, it must be paired with a Standard Hydrogen Electrode (SHE). By definition, all reacting ionic concentrations must be exactly 1 M and gas pressures must be balanced at 1 bar, rendering the measured cell potential equal to the standard electrode potential.

qe: The Nernst equation for a magnesium electrode is written as $E = E^\circ - \frac{0.059}{2}\log\frac{1}{[\text{Mg}^{2+}]}$. What type of graph describes the dynamic variation of $E$ versus $\log[\text{Mg}^{2+}]$?
qh: एक मैग्नीशियम इलेक्ट्रोड के लिए नर्स्ट समीकरण $E = E^\circ - \frac{0.059}{2}\log\frac{1}{[\text{Mg}^{2+}]}$ है। $E$ बनाम $\log[\text{Mg}^{2+}]$ के गतिशील परिवर्तन को किस प्रकार का ग्राफ दर्शाता है?
o: A straight line with a negative slope and zero intercept
A straight line with a positive slope equal to $\frac{0.059}{2}$ and a positive intercept equal to $E^\circ$ (धनात्मक ढाल वाली सीधी रेखा)
A curved parabolic line approaching horizontal absolute thresholds
A strictly horizontal line running completely independent of concentration changes
e: Explanation: Rearranging the equation yields $E = \left(\frac{0.059}{2}\right)\log[\text{Mg}^{2+}] + E^\circ$. This matches the equation of a straight line ($y = mx + c$). Plotting $E$ vs $\log[\text{Mg}^{2+}]$ yields a straight line with a positive slope ($m = 0.0295\text{ V}$) and an intercept ($c$) equal to $E^\circ$.

qe: How are the cell potential ($E_{\text{cell}}$) and the Gibbs free energy change ($\Delta_r G$) categorized based on thermodynamic definitions of property scale?
qh: थर्मोडायनामिक परिभाषाओं के आधार पर सेल विभव ($E_{\text{cell}}$) और गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा परिवर्तन ($\Delta_r G$) को संपत्ति पैमाने (property scale) के अनुसार कैसे वर्गीकृत किया जाता है?
o: Both are extensive properties scaling with mass indexes
Both are intensive properties independent of concentration loops
$E_{\text{cell}}$ is an intensive property, while $\Delta_r G$ is an extensive property ($E_{cell}$ गहन गुण तथा $\Delta_r G$ विस्तीर्ण गुण है)
$E_{\text{cell}}$ is an extensive property, while $\Delta_r G$ is an intensive property
e: Explanation: Cell potential ($E_{\text{cell}}$) is an intensive property because its voltage value is independent of the amount of substance or the scale of the system. Conversely, the Gibbs free energy change ($\Delta_r G$) is extensive because its absolute energy output depends directly on the number of moles of reacting species ($n$).

qe: What precise descriptive terminology defines the potential difference developed between two electrodes when zero net electrical current is being drawn from the cell circuit?
qh: जब सेल सर्किट से कोई शुद्ध विद्युत धारा नहीं खींची जा रही हो, तो दो इलेक्ट्रोडों के बीच विकसित संभावित अंतर को कौन सी सटीक वर्णनात्मक शब्दावली परिभाषित करती है?
o: Dynamic cell voltage
Cell Electromotive Force (Cell EMF / सेल विद्युत वाहक बल)
Vinylic structural overpotential
Oligomeric internal resistance
e: Explanation: The potential difference between two half-cells measured under open-circuit conditions (when no external current flows through the setup) is formally defined as the cell electromotive force (EMF).

qe: Which operational characteristic is true regarding the function of an inert electrode (such as platinum) inside an electrochemical cell?
qh: एक इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल सेल के भीतर एक अक्रिय इलेक्ट्रोड (जैसे प्लैटिनम) के कार्य के संबंध में कौन सी परिचालन विशेषता सत्य है?
o: It dissolves into the electrolyte to participate directly in the cell reaction
It provides a surface layer either for oxidation or reduction reactions by facilitating electron conduction without undergoing chemical change (केवल इलेक्ट्रॉन चालन के लिए सतह प्रदान करना)
It functions as an active cross-linking agent that hardens the solution
It provides a surface layer for a full simultaneous redox reaction across its face
e: Explanation: An inert electrode does not enter the net chemical reaction or undergo oxidation/reduction. It serves purely as an unreactive electronic conductor that provides a structural surface for single electron exchange steps.

qe: Under what structural conditions will a standard Galvanic cell alter its behavior to function as an electrolytic cell?
qh: किन संरचनात्मक स्थितियों में एक मानक गैल्वेनिक सेल एक इलेक्ट्रोलाइटिक सेल के रूप में कार्य करने के लिए अपने व्यवहार को बदल देगा?
o: When the internal cell potential drops exactly to zero volts
When an external opposing voltage exceeds the native cell potential value ($E_{\text{ext}} > E_{\text{cell}}$) ($E_{ext} > E_{cell}$ होने पर)
When the concentration of the electrolyte reaches absolute infinity
When the salt bridge is completely removed from the compartment setup
e: Explanation: If an opposing external potential ($E_{\text{ext}}$) is applied to a Galvanic cell and increased beyond the cell's native potential ($E_{\text{cell}}$), the net current is forced to flow in the opposite direction. This drives non-spontaneous reactions, transforming it into an electrolytic cell.

qe: Which factor is incorrectly described regarding its physical influence over the electrical conductivity of an electrolytic solution?
qh: एक इलेक्ट्रोलाइटिक समाधान की विद्युत चालकता पर उसके भौतिक प्रभाव के संबंध में कौन सा कारक गलत तरीके से वर्णित है?
o: Conductivity is dependent on the size and mobility of the moving ions
Conductivity drops significantly when the system operational temperature is raised (तापमान बढ़ने पर चालकता घटने का कथन गलत है)
Conductivity decreases when the internal viscosity of the solvent expands
Conductivity is influenced by the degree of solvation anchoring the ions
e: Explanation: The electrical conductivity of an electrolytic solution expands as temperature rises because higher kinetic energy enhances ion mobility and lowers solvent viscosity. Therefore, stating that conductivity decreases with temperature is incorrect.

qe: Based on the standard reduction potentials provided: $E^\circ_{\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-}/\text{Cr}^{3+}} = 1.33\text{ V}$, $E^\circ_{\text{Cl}_2/\text{Cl}^-} = 1.36\text{ V}$, $E^\circ_{\text{MnO}_4^-/\text{Mn}^{2+}} = 1.51\text{ V}$, $E^\circ_{\text{Cr}^{3+}/\text{Cr}} = -0.74\text{ V}$. Which chemical species functions as the strongest reducing agent?
qh: दिए गए मानक अपचयन विभवों के आधार पर: $E^\circ_{\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-}/\text{Cr}^{3+}} = 1.33\text{ V}$, $E^\circ_{\text{Cl}_2/\text{Cl}^-} = 1.36\text{ V}$, $E^\circ_{\text{MnO}_4^-/\text{Mn}^{2+}} = 1.51\text{ V}$, $E^\circ_{\text{Cr}^{3+}/\text{Cr}} = -0.74\text{ V}$। कौन सी रासायनिक प्रजाति सबसे मजबूत अपचायक के रूप में कार्य करती है?
o: $\text{Cl}^-$
$\text{Cr}$ (क्रोमियम धातु)
e: Explanation: The strongest reducing agent is the species that undergoes oxidation most easily, corresponding to the most negative standard reduction potential. Chromium metal ($ ext{Cr}$) features the lowest reduction potential ($-0.74 ext{ V}$), making it the strongest reducing agent listed.

qe: Using the data: $E^\circ_{\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-}/\text{Cr}^{3+}} = 1.33\text{ V}$, $E^\circ_{\text{Cl}_2/\text{Cl}^-} = 1.36\text{ V}$, $E^\circ_{\text{MnO}_4^-/\text{Mn}^{2+}} = 1.51\text{ V}$, $E^\circ_{\text{Cr}^{3+}/\text{Cr}} = -0.74\text{ V}$. Identify the strongest oxidizing agent in this group.
qh: डेटा का उपयोग करके: $E^\circ_{\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-}/\text{Cr}^{3+}} = 1.33\text{ V}$, $E^\circ_{\text{Cl}_2/\text{Cl}^-} = 1.36\text{ V}$, $E^\circ_{\text{MnO}_4^-/\text{Mn}^{2+}} = 1.51\text{ V}$, $E^\circ_{\text{Cr}^{3+}/\text{Cr}} = -0.74\text{ V}$। इस समूह में सबसे मजबूत ऑक्सीकरण एजेंट की पहचान करें।
o: $\text{Cl}_2$
$\text{MnO}_4^-$ (परमैंगनेट आयन)
e: Explanation: The strongest oxidizing agent is the species that has the highest tendency to undergo reduction, which corresponds to the largest positive standard reduction potential value. The perpermanganate ion ($\text{MnO}_4^-$) has the highest value ($1.51\text{ V}$), making it the strongest oxidizing agent.

qe: Reviewing the reduction data: $\text{Mn}^{2+} (1.51\text{ V})$, $\text{Cl}_2 (1.36\text{ V})$, $\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-} (1.33\text{ V})$, and $\text{Cr}^{3+} (-0.74\text{ V})$, which option correctly sequences the increasing order of reducing power across these species?
qh: अपचयन डेटा की समीक्षा करते हुए: $\text{Mn}^{2+} (1.51\text{ V})$, $\text{Cl}_2 (1.36\text{ V})$, $\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-} (1.33\text{ V})$, और $\text{Cr}^{3+} (-0.74\text{ V})$, कौन सा विकल्प इन प्रजातियों में अपचायक क्षमता (reducing power) के बढ़ते क्रम को सही ढंग से दर्शाता है?
o: $\text{Cr}^{3+} < \text{Cl}^- < \text{Mn}^{2+} < \text{Cr}$
$\text{Mn}^{2+} < \text{Cl}^- < \text{Cr}^{3+} < \text{Cr}$ (बढ़ती अपचायक क्षमता का सही क्रम)
$\text{Cr}^{3+} < \text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-} < \text{Cl}^- < \text{MnO}_4^-$
$\text{Mn}^{2+} < \text{Cr}^{3+} < \text{Cl}^- < \text{Cr}$
e: Explanation: Reducing power is inversely proportional to the standard reduction potential. As the standard reduction potential decreases from positive values to negative values, the capacity of the species to act as a reducing agent increases, yielding the sequence: $\text{Mn}^{2+} < \text{Cl}^- < \text{Cr}^{3+} < \text{Cr}$.

qe: What quantitative magnitude of electrical charge is required to reduce exactly one mole of aluminum ions from an aqueous $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ solution into solid aluminum?
qh: जलीय $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ घोल से बिल्कुल एक मोल एल्यूमीनियम आयनों को ठोस एल्यूमीनियम में अपचयित (reduce) करने के लिए विद्युत आवेश के किस मात्रात्मक परिमाण की आवश्यकता होती है?
o: 1 Faraday ($1\text{ F}$)
6 Faradays ($6\text{ F}$)
3 Faradays ($3\text{ F}$ - तीन फैराडे आवेश)
2 Faradays ($2\text{ F}$)
e: Explanation: Reducing an aluminum ion involves the addition half-reaction: $\text{Al}^{3+} + 3e^- \rightarrow \text{Al}(s)$. Reducing exactly 1 mole of $\text{Al}^{3+}$ requires 3 moles of electrons, which is equivalent to 3 Faradays ($3\text{ F}$) of electrical charge.

qe: How does the cell constant ($G^*$) of a specific commercial conductivity cell behave when changes are made to the electrolyte concentration or temperature parameters?
qh: एक विशिष्ट वाणिज्यिक चालकता सेल का सेल स्थिरांक ($G^*$) कैसा व्यवहार करता है जब इलेक्ट्रोलाइट सांद्रता या तापमान मापदंडों में परिवर्तन किया जाता है?
o: It shifts dynamically whenever the chemical nature of the electrolyte is altered
It changes linearly alongside modifications in solution temperature
It remains completely constant for a given cell because it depends strictly on fixed physical dimensions (स्थिर रहना)
It drops down to absolute zero value when high-purity water is introduced
e: Explanation: The cell constant ($G^*$) is determined by the fixed physical dimensions of the cell, defined by the ratio of the distance between the electrodes to their area ($G^* = \ell/A$). It is independent of electrolyte concentration, temperature, or chemical identity.

qe: What specific chemical transformation occurs at the anode when a depleted commercial lead storage battery is subjected to an external recharging cycle?
qh: जब एक डिस्चार्ज हो चुकी वाणिज्यिक लेड स्टोरेज बैटरी को बाहरी रिचार्जिंग चक्र के अधीन किया जाता है तो एनोड पर कौन सा विशिष्ट रासायनिक परिवर्तन होता है?
o: Solid $\text{PbSO}_4$ is reduced to metallic $\text{Pb}$ sheets
Solid $\text{PbSO}_4$ is oxidized into solid lead dioxide ($\text{PbO}_2$) bridges (अम्लीय एनोड पर $\text{PbO}_2$ का बनना)
Liquid water splits into volatile open-chain carbohydrate networks
Metallic lead is completely dissolved into volatile open-chain sulfate gases
e: Explanation: During the external recharging cycle of a lead storage battery, the cell reactions are reversed. The solid lead sulfate ($ ext{PbSO}_4$) adhering to the anode undergoes oxidation, converting back into solid lead dioxide ($ ext{PbO}_2$): $ ext{PbSO}_4(s) + 2 ext{H}_2 ext{O} \rightarrow ext{PbO}_2(s) + ext{SO}_4^{2-} + 4 ext{H}^+ + 2e^-$.

qe: According to Kohlrausch's law of independent ion migration, the limiting molar conductivity of ammonium hydroxide [$\Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NH}_4\text{OH})$] can be calculated using which setup?
qh: आयनों के स्वतंत्र प्रवासन के कोलराउश के नियम के अनुसार, अमोनियम हाइड्रॉक्साइड [$\Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NH}_4\text{OH})$] की सीमित मोलर चालकता की गणना किस सेटअप का उपयोग करके की जा सकती है?
o: $\Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NH}_4\text{OH}) = \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NH}_4\text{Cl}) + \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{HCl}) - \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NaOH})$
$\Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NH}_4\text{OH}) = \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NH}_4\text{Cl}) + \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NaOH}) - \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NaCl})$ (कोलराउश नियम संयोजन)
$\Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NH}_4\text{OH}) = \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NH}_4\text{Cl}) + \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NaCl}) - \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NaOH})$
$\Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NH}_4\text{OH}) = \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NaOH}) + \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NaCl}) - \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NH}_4\text{Cl})$
e: Explanation: Kohlrausch's law states that the limiting molar conductivity of an electrolyte is the sum of its individual ionic values. Combining the components yields: $\Lambda^\circ(\text{NH}_4^+) + \Lambda^\circ(\text{Cl}^-) + \Lambda^\circ(\text{Na}^+) + \Lambda^\circ(\text{OH}^-) - [\Lambda^\circ(\text{Na}^+) + \Lambda^\circ(\text{Cl}^-)] = \Lambda^\circ(\text{NH}_4^+) + \Lambda^\circ(\text{OH}^-)$, which corresponds to option 2.

qe: During the industrial electrolysis of a concentrated aqueous sodium chloride solution ($	ext{NaCl}$), which specific half-cell reaction selectively proceeds at the anode compartment?
qh: सांद्र जलीय सोडियम क्लोराइड समाधान ($	ext{NaCl}$) के औद्योगिक विद्युत अपघटन के दौरान एनोड कम्पार्टमेंट पर कौन सी विशिष्ट हाफ-सेल प्रतिक्रिया चुनिंदा रूप से आगे बढ़ती है?
o: $\text{Na}^+(aq) + e^- \rightarrow \text{Na}(s); \, E^\circ = -2.71\text{ V}$
$2\text{H}_2\text{O}(l) \rightarrow \text{O}_2(g) + 4\text{H}^+(aq) + 4e^-; \, E^\circ = 1.23\text{ V}$
$\text{Cl}^-(aq) \rightarrow \frac{1}{2}\text{Cl}_2(g) + e^-; \, E^\circ = 1.36\text{ V}$ (क्लोराइड ऑक्सीकरण प्रतिक्रिया)
$\text{H}^+(aq) + e^- \rightarrow \frac{1}{2}\text{H}_2(g); \, E^\circ = 0.00\text{ V}$
e: Explanation: At the anode of an aqueous $NaCl$ cell, chloride ions and water molecules compete for oxidation. Although water has a lower standard potential ($1.23\text{ V}$), water oxidation is kinetically slow and requires an overvoltage, allowing chloride ions to undergo oxidation preferentially to liberate chlorine gas ($Cl_2$).

qe: What does a large positive value for the standard reduction potential of the $\text{Cu}^{2+}/\text{Cu}$ redox couple ($+0.34\text{ V}$) indicate about its chemical behavior relative to the hydrogen couple?
qh: $\text{Cu}^{2+}/\text{Cu}$ रेडॉक्स युगल ($+0.34\text{ V}$) के मानक अपचयन विभव का एक बड़ा धनात्मक मान हाइड्रोजन युगल के सापेक्ष इसके रासायनिक व्यवहार के बारे में क्या दर्शाता है?
o: This redox couple is a stronger reducing agent than the hydrogen couple
The $\text{Cu}^{2+}$ ion undergoes reduction more easily than $\text{H}^+$ ions, and copper metal cannot displace $\text{H}_2$ gas from acids (तांबा अम्लों से हाइड्रोजन विस्थापित नहीं कर सकता)
Copper metal reacts violently with dilute acids to generate large volumes of hydrogen gas
The copper electrode functions as a highly volatile liquid non-ionic detergent sheet
e: Explanation: A positive reduction potential means that $\text{Cu}^{2+}$ is a stronger oxidizing agent than $\text{H}^+$, meaning it is reduced more easily. Consequently, metallic copper ($\text{Cu}$) is more stable than hydrogen gas and cannot displace $\text{H}_2$ gas from acidic solutions.

qe: During the quantitative electrolysis of a dilute aqueous sulfuric acid solution ($H_2SO_4$), which explicit reaction takes place at the anode terminal?
qh: एक तनु जलीय सल्फ्यूरिक एसिड समाधान ($H_2SO_4$) के मात्रात्मक विद्युत अपघटन के दौरान एनोड टर्मिनल पर कौन सी स्पष्ट प्रतिक्रिया होती है?
o: Sulfate ions are oxidized into peroxodisulfate ions ($S_2O_8^{2-}$)
Water molecules undergo selective oxidation to liberate oxygen gas ($O_2$) (तनु विलयन में पानी का ऑक्सीकरण होकर $O_2$ निकलना)
Hydronium ions are reduced to release hydrogen gas streams
The platinum wire is completely dissolved into volatile open-chain sulfate clusters
e: Explanation: In a dilute solution of sulfuric acid, water molecules undergo oxidation at the anode preferentially over sulfate ions because water oxidation features a lower potential threshold ($1.23\text{ V}$ vs $1.96\text{ V}$ for sulfate), resulting in the continuous evolution of oxygen gas ($O_2$).

qe: When an industrial electrolysis operation is shifted to run inside a highly concentrated sulfuric acid solution, what change occurs to the anodic reaction profile?
qh: जब एक औद्योगिक विद्युत अपघटन संचालन को अत्यधिक सांद्र सल्फ्यूरिक एसिड समाधान के भीतर चलाने के लिए स्थानांतरित किया जाता है, तो एनोडिक प्रतिक्रिया प्रोफ़ाइल में क्या परिवर्तन होता है?
o: Water oxidation accelerates to release ten times more oxygen gas
Sulfate ions are oxidized preferentially to synthesize peroxodisulfate ions ($\text{S}_2\text{O}_8^{2-}$) (सांद्र विलयन में सल्फेट का ऑक्सीकरण होना)
The entire solution turns completely bio-degradable within seconds
Metallic copper plates out onto the anode surface irreversibly
e: Explanation: In highly concentrated solutions of sulfuric acid ($H_2SO_4$), the high concentration of sulfate ions shifts the anodic preference away from water. Sulfate ions are oxidized preferentially to yield peroxodisulfate ions ($ ext{S}_2 ext{O}_8^{2-}$): $2 ext{SO}_4^{2-} \rightarrow ext{S}_2 ext{O}_8^{2-} + 2e^-$.

qe: The standard potential of a classic Daniell cell is exactly 1.1 V. Which logarithmic mathematical expression correctly details its thermodynamic equilibrium state at 298 K?
qh: एक क्लासिक डेनियल सेल का मानक विभव बिल्कुल 1.1 V है। कौन सा लघुगणकीय गणितीय व्यंजक (logarithmic mathematical expression) 298 K पर इसकी थर्मोडायनामिक संतुलन स्थिति का सही विवरण देता है?
o: $\log K_C = 1.1 \times 2F$
$\log K_C = \frac{2.2}{0.059}$ (डेनियल सेल संतुलन समीकरण)
$\log K_C = -1.1 \times nF$
$\log K_C = 1.1 \times 0.059$
e: Explanation: At chemical equilibrium, the Nernst equation simplifies to: $E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = \frac{0.059}{n}\log K_C$. For a Daniell cell, substituting $n = 2$ and $E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = 1.1\text{ V}$ yields $1.1 = \frac{0.059}{2}\log K_C$, which rearranges directly to $\log K_C = \frac{2.2}{0.059}$.

qe: What precise macro-structural modification describes the spatial architecture of the peroxodisulfate anion ($\text{S}_2\text{O}_8^{2-}$), which is synthesized via high-concentration sulfate oxidation?
qh: अत्यधिक सांद्र सल्फेट ऑक्सीकरण के माध्यम से संश्लेषित पेरोक्सोडिसल्फेट आयन ($\text{S}_2\text{O}_8^{2-}$) की स्थानिक वास्तुकला का क्या सटीक विवरण है?
o: It consists of a simple linear unbranched polyolefin tail chain
It contains two sulfur atoms linked symmetrically through a central peroxide single bond ($-O-O-$) bridge (पेरोक्साइड एकल बंध पुल की उपस्थिति)
It features a cyclic pyranose ring closed by an interactive oxygen bridge
It establishes a permanent shared-electron covalent junction with metal cations
e: Explanation: The peroxodisulfate ion ($ ext{S}_2 ext{O}_8^{2-}$, derived from Marshall's acid) features two tetrahedral sulfur atoms linked via a central peroxide single bond oxygen bridge ($-O-O-$), with each sulfur atom holding an additional three oxygen ligands.

qe: What physical status characterizes the value of a cell's standard reduction potential indicator ($E^\circ$) relative to mass action effects?
qh: द्रव्यमान क्रिया प्रभावों (mass action effects) के सापेक्ष किसी सेल के मानक अपचयन विभव संकेतक ($E^\circ$) के मान की क्या भौतिक स्थिति विशेषता है?
o: It scales linearly with changes in the mass or volume of the electrolyte
It is an intensive thermodynamic property that remains entirely constant regardless of stoichiometric coefficients or reaction scaling (गहन गुण होना)
It converts into an extensive parameter when combined with a salt bridge
It drops to zero volts when the cell reaches chemical equilibrium parameters
e: Explanation: Standard reduction potential ($E^\circ$) is an intensive property that is independent of reaction scale or stoichiometric coefficients. This separates it from extensive parameters like the Gibbs free energy change.

qe: Which specific intermediate chemical compound is isolated during the initial condensation steps of a phenol-formaldehyde reaction before it cross-links to form Bakelite panels?
qh: फिनोल-फॉर्मलाडेहाइड प्रतिक्रिया के शुरुआती चरणों में कौन सा विशिष्ट मध्यवर्ती रासायनिक यौगिक (intermediate chemical compound) अलग किया जाता है, इससे पहले कि यह बैकेलाइट बनाने के लिए क्रॉस-लिंक हो?
o: Melamine formal resin sheet
Novolac linear chain resin (नोवोलेक)
Polyacrylonitrile fiber strand
Buna-S synthetic elastomer grid
e: Explanation: The condensation reaction between phenol and formaldehyde initially produces Novolac, a linear polymer resin. Heating Novolac with excess formaldehyde introduces methylene bridges, cross-linking the chains into the rigid thermosetting plastic Bakelite.

qe: Which specific organic molecule functions as the initial monomer building block required to construct a natural rubber elastomer network?
qh: एक प्राकृतिक रबर इलास्टोमर नेटवर्क के निर्माण के लिए आवश्यक प्रारंभिक मोनोमर बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक के रूप में कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक अणु कार्य करता है?
o: Chloroprene (2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene)
Isoprene (2-methylbuta-1,3-diene) (आइसोप्रीन)
Acrylonitrile (prop-2-enonitrile)
Styrene (phenylethylene) aromatic
e: Explanation: Natural rubber is a linear homopolymer composed of repeating isoprene units. Under systematic IUPAC rules, isoprene is designated as 2-methylbuta-1,3-diene.

qe: The ring-opening chemical polymerization of the cyclic amide monomer caprolactam at high temperatures yields which industrial poly-amide material?
qh: उच्च तापमान पर चक्रीय एमाइड मोनोमर कैप्रोलैक्टम का रिंग-ओपनिंग रासायनिक पॉलीमराइजेशन किस औद्योगिक पॉली-एमाइड सामग्री को उत्पन्न करता है?
o: Nylon-6,6 fiber sheets
Nylon-6 poly-amide (नायलॉन-6)
Melamine formal breakproof resin
Buna-N synthetic elastomeric rubber
e: Explanation: Heating the seven-membered cyclic lactam caprolactam with water drives a ring-opening polymerization process, aligning the fragments into a linear polyamide chain known as Nylon-6.

qe: What specific operational designation distinguishes a polymer synthesized by processing two or more entirely different monomer species within the same structural chain framework?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट परिचालन पदनाम एक ही संरचनात्मक श्रृंखला ढांचे के भीतर दो या दो से अधिक पूरी तरह से अलग मोनोमर प्रजातियों को संसाधित करके संश्लेषित पॉलिमर को अलग करता है?
o: Homopolymer matrix sheet
Copolymer (सह बहुलक)
Thermosetting network panel
Linear tactical oligomer layer
e: Explanation: Polymers synthesized by polymerizing a mixture of two or more structurally distinct monomer species are classified as copolymers (e.g., Buna-S, compiled from butadiene and styrene).

qe: What type of intermolecular force stabilizes the secondary structural motifs of proteins, specifically maintaining the shape of alpha-helices and beta-pleated sheets?
qh: किस प्रकार का अंतर-आणविक बल प्रोटीन के माध्यमिक संरचनात्मक रूपांकनों (secondary structural motifs) को स्थिर करता है, विशेष रूप से अल्फा-हेलिस और बीटा-प्लीटेड शीट के आकार को बनाए रखता है?
o: Weak van der Waals dispersion forces entirely across chains
Intermolecular or intramolecular Hydrogen bonds established between amide groups (हाइड्रोजन आबंधन)
Reversible ester links that undergo rapid biological cleavage
Cationic quaternary nitrogen halide coordinate grids
e: Explanation: The secondary structure of proteins is stabilized by hydrogen bonding between the carbonyl oxygen atom ($C=O$) and the amide hydrogen atom ($N-H$) along the peptide backbones.

qe: Which specific organic functional group connection links consecutive monosaccharide units together to build high molecular weight polysaccharides like starch and cellulose?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक कार्यात्मक समूह कनेक्शन लगातार मोनोसेकेराइड इकाइयों को एक साथ जोड़कर स्टार्च और सेलुलोज जैसे उच्च आणविक भार वाले पॉलीसेकेराइड का निर्माण करता है?
o: Peptide linkage holding amino residues
Glycosidic linkage (ग्लाइकोसिडिक बंध)
Phosphodiester bridging matrix channel
Disulfide cross-link bridge system
e: Explanation: Monosaccharide rings couple via condensation reactions to build complex carbohydrates. The resulting carbon-oxygen-carbon covalent connection linking the rings is termed a glycosidic linkage.

qe: What type of macromolecular structural linkage connects consecutive nucleotide monomers together along a strand of DNA or RNA?
qh: डीएनए या आरएनए की एक श्रृंखला के साथ लगातार न्यूक्लियोटाइड मोनोमर्स को किस प्रकार का मैक्रोमोलेक्यूलर संरचनात्मक लिंकेज जोड़ता है?
o: Glycosidic carbon-oxygen linkage bridging components
Phosphodiester linkage establishing bridges between 5' and 3' carbons (फॉस्फोडिएस्टर बंध / लिंक)
Methylene bridge framework generated via condensation polymerization
Amide linkage systematically identical to a biological peptide bond
e: Explanation: Nucleotides polymerize to form nucleic acids through phosphodiester linkages. This covalent bridge connects the 5' carbon atom of one sugar ring to the 3' position of the adjacent nucleotide unit.

qe: What organizational level of protein structure describes the specific linear sequence in which amino acid residues are covalently linked within a polypeptide chain?
qh: प्रोटीन संरचना का कौन सा संगठनात्मक स्तर उस विशिष्ट रैखिक अनुक्रम का वर्णन करता है जिसमें अमीनो एसिड अवशेष एक पॉलीपेप्टाइड श्रृंखला के भीतर सहसंयोजक रूप से जुड़े होते हैं?
o: Primary structure (प्राथमिक संरचना)
Secondary sheet configuration
Tertiary global folding matrix
Quaternary multi-subunit grid layout
e: Explanation: The primary structure of a protein is defined by the unique linear sequence of its constituent amino acids linked via peptide bonds. This sequence dictates all subsequent folding levels.

qe: Which specific organic compound name represents the functional molecular structure of Vitamin C?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक यौगिक नाम विटामिन सी की कार्यात्मक आणविक संरचना का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है?
o: Thiamine hydrochloride group
Ascorbic acid (एस्कॉर्बिक अम्ल)
Heterocyclic caprolactam ring
Cyanocobalamin core complex
e: Explanation: Vitamin C is an unsaturated sugar acid systematically and chemically designated as ascorbic acid, known for its essential antioxidant roles in biological systems.

qe: Which physical parameter variations directly determine the electrical conductivity profile of a standard electrolytic solution?
qh: कौन से भौतिक पैरामीटर परिवर्तन सीधे एक मानक इलेक्ट्रोलाइटिक समाधान के विद्युत चालकता प्रोफ़ाइल को निर्धारित करते हैं?
o: The chemical nature of the electrolyte and its localized concentration indices (इलेक्ट्रोलाइट की प्रकृति एवं सांद्रता)
The total power output of the external AC source applied to the circuit
The physical distance separating the two operational electrodes
The structural surface area of the platinum sheets immersed in fluid
e: Explanation: The electrical conductivity ($\kappa$) of an electrolytic solution relies on the presence and migration of mobile ions. Consequently, its magnitude is dictated by the chemical nature of the electrolyte, ionic size, solvation tendencies, concentration parameters, solvent viscosity, and ambient temperature, while electrode geometry has no effect.

qe: According to Kohlrausch's law of independent ion migration, the limiting molar conductivity of pure water [$\Lambda^\circ_m(\text{H}_2\text{O})$] can be mathematically derived using which unique combination of strong electrolytes?
qh: आयनों के स्वतंत्र प्रवासन के कोलराउश के नियम के अनुसार, शुद्ध पानी की सीमित मोलर चालकता [$\Lambda^\circ_m(\text{H}_2\text{O})$] को मजबूत इलेक्ट्रोलाइट्स के किस अनूठे संयोजन का उपयोग करके गणितीय रूप से प्राप्त किया जा सकता है?
o: $\Lambda^\circ_m(\text{HNO}_3) + \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NaNO}_3) - \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NaOH})$
$\Lambda^\circ_m(\text{HCl}) + \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NaOH}) - \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NaCl})$ (कोलराउश नियम द्वारा पानी का मान)
$\Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NH}_4\text{OH}) + \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{HCl}) - \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NH}_4\text{Cl})$
$\Lambda^\circ_m(\text{HNO}_3) + \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NaOH}) - \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{NaNO}_3)$
e: Explanation: Kohlrausch's law states that at infinite dilution, the total molar conductivity equals the sum of the individual ionic contributions. Combining the strong electrolytes yields: $\Lambda^\circ(\text{H}^+) + \Lambda^\circ(\text{Cl}^-) + \Lambda^\circ(\text{Na}^+) + \Lambda^\circ(\text{OH}^-) - [\Lambda^\circ(\text{Na}^+) + \Lambda^\circ(\text{Cl}^-)] = \Lambda^\circ(\text{H}^+) + \Lambda^\circ(\text{OH}^-) = \Lambda^\circ_m(\text{H}_2\text{O})$, which matches option 2.

qe: During the quantitative electrolysis of an aqueous copper sulfate ($\text{CuSO}_4$) solution using inert platinum electrodes, which distinct products emerge at the cathode and anode respectively?
qh: अक्रिय प्लैटिनम इलेक्ट्रोड का उपयोग करके जलीय कॉपर सल्फेट ($\text{CuSO}_4$) समाधान के मात्रात्मक विद्युत अपघटन के दौरान, क्रमशः कैथोड और एनोड पर कौन से विशिष्ट उत्पाद उभरते हैं?
o: Copper metal dissolves at the anode, and oxygen gas is captured at the cathode
Metallic copper plates out at the cathode, and oxygen gas is liberated at the anode (कैथोड पर तांबा तथा एनोड पर ऑक्सीजन)
Hydrogen gas evolves at the cathode, and solid sulfur precipitates at the anode
Copper metal deposits at the anode, and water undergoes reduction at the cathode
e: Explanation: In aqueous $\text{CuSO}_4$ with inert electrodes, $\text{Cu}^{2+}$ ions undergo reduction at the negative terminal (cathode) more easily than $\text{H}^+$ ions, depositing metallic copper: $\text{Cu}^{2+} + 2e^- \rightarrow \text{Cu}(s)$. At the positive terminal (anode), water oxidation is favored over sulfate, liberating oxygen gas: $2\text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{O}_2(g) + 4\text{H}^+ + 4e^-$.

qe: How does substituting inert platinum with active copper electrodes fundamentally alter the anodic reaction profile during the electrolysis of aqueous $\text{CuSO}_4$?
qh: जलीय $\text{CuSO}_4$ के विद्युत अपघटन के दौरान अक्रिय प्लैटिनम को सक्रिय कॉपर इलेक्ट्रोड से बदलने से एनोडिक प्रतिक्रिया प्रोफ़ाइल में क्या मौलिक परिवर्तन होता है?
o: Oxygen gas is released at the anode at twice its normal speed
Copper metal from the active anode undergoes oxidation and dissolves into the solution as $\text{Cu}^{2+}$ ions (एनोड पर कॉपर का घुलना)
Sulfate ions are oxidized into peroxodisulfate segments at the anode surface
Hydrogen gas is selectively liberated at the anode terminal layer
e: Explanation: When active copper electrodes are utilized, the copper metal at the anode undergoes oxidation more easily than water or sulfate ions. Thus, instead of gas evolution, the copper anode dissolves: $\text{Cu}(s) \rightarrow \text{Cu}^{2+} + 2e^-$, while $\text{Cu}^{2+}$ deposits at the cathode.

qe: Which specific equation accurately defines specific conductivity ($\kappa$) in terms of resistance ($R$) and cell dimensions?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट समीकरण प्रतिरोध ($R$) और सेल आयामों के संदर्भ में विशिष्ट चालकता ($\kappa$) को सटीक रूप से परिभाषित करता है?
o: $\kappa = \frac{1}{R} \cdot \frac{\ell}{A} = \frac{G^*}{R}$ (चालकता, प्रतिरोध एवं सेल स्थिरांक संबंध)
$\kappa = R \cdot G^*$
$\kappa = \Lambda_m \cdot \frac{A}{\ell}$
$\kappa = \frac{R}{\ell \cdot A}$
e: Explanation: Conductivity ($\kappa$) is defined as the reciprocal of resistivity ($\kappa = 1/\rho$). Since $\rho = R \cdot (A/\ell)$, substituting this yields $\kappa = \frac{1}{R} \cdot \left(\frac{\ell}{A}\right) = \frac{G^*}{R}$, where $G^*$ represents the fixed cell constant.

qe: Which set of operational parameters governs the dynamic magnitude of molar conductivity for an ionic solution?
qh: परिचालन मापदंडों (operational parameters) का कौन सा सेट एक आयनिक समाधान के लिए मोलर चालकता के गतिशील परिमाण को नियंत्रित करता है?
o: The physical distance between electrodes and their total structural surface area
The system temperature and the localized concentration of electrolytes inside the solution (तापमान एवं इलेक्ट्रोलाइट सांद्रता)
The absolute volume of gas trapped inside the salt bridge gel matrix
The thickness of the non-conducting plastic shield surrounding the cell
e: Explanation: Molar conductivity ($\Lambda_m = \kappa/C$) is heavily dependent on temperature and concentration. Higher temperatures lower viscosity and increase ionic mobility, expanding $\Lambda_m$, whereas increasing electrolyte concentration typically decreases $\Lambda_m$ due to inter-ionic interactions.

qe: For the standard Galvanic cell notation represented by $\text{Mg} \mid \text{Mg}^{2+} \parallel \text{Cu}^{2+} \mid \text{Cu}$, what is the correct full cell reaction?
qh: $\text{Mg} \mid \text{Mg}^{2+} \parallel \text{Cu}^{2+} \mid \text{Cu}$ द्वारा दर्शाए गए मानक गैल्वेनिक सेल संकेतन के लिए सही पूर्ण सेल प्रतिक्रिया क्या है?
o: $\text{Cu} + \text{Mg}^{2+} \rightarrow \text{Cu}^{2+} + \text{Mg}$
$\text{Mg} + \text{Cu}^{2+} \rightarrow \text{Mg}^{2+} + \text{Cu}$ (सही सेल प्रतिक्रिया)
$\text{Mg}^{2+} + \text{Cu}^{2+} \rightarrow \text{Mg} + \text{Cu}$
$\text{Mg} + \text{Cu} \rightarrow \text{Mg}^{2+} + \text{Cu}^{2+}$
e: Explanation: In standard notation, the left side tracks the anode oxidation half-reaction ($ ext{Mg} \rightarrow \text{Mg}^{2+} + 2e^-$), and the right side tracks the cathode reduction half-reaction ($ ext{Cu}^{2+} + 2e^- \rightarrow \text{Cu}$). Combining these steps yields the net reaction: $ ext{Mg} + ext{Cu}^{2+} \rightarrow ext{Mg}^{2+} + ext{Cu}$.

qe: Why is it physically impossible to measure the absolute electrode potential profile of an isolated individual half-cell directly?
qh: किसी पृथक व्यक्तिगत हाफ-सेल के पूर्ण इलेक्ट्रोड विभव प्रोफाइल को सीधे मापना भौतिक रूप से असंभव क्यों है?
o: Because half-cells turn volatile when isolated from structural air boundaries
Because a chemical oxidation or reduction half-reaction cannot take place independently without a complementary counter-reaction (अकेले हाफ-सेल में कोई नेट अभिक्रिया संभव नहीं है)
Because it requires the complete removal of all oxygen groups from the solution
Because it causes the immediate common-ion precipitation of all ionic reagents
e: Explanation: An absolute potential of a single electrode cannot be determined because oxidation and reduction half-reactions are coupled processes that cannot occur in isolation. Only relative potential differences can be measured by pairing the half-cell with a standard reference electrode.

qe: Can the standard cell potential ($E^\circ_{\text{cell}}$) or standard Gibbs free energy change ($\Delta_r G^\circ$) of a feasible, functioning electrochemical cell ever be equal to zero?
qh: क्या एक व्यवहार्य, चालू इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल सेल का मानक सेल विभव ($E^\circ_{\text{cell}}$) या मानक गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा परिवर्तन ($\Delta_r G^\circ$) कभी शून्य के बराबर हो सकता है?
o: Yes, when the circuit is kept entirely open at room temperature boundaries

No, because a feasible reaction requires a positive $E^\circ_{\text{cell}}$ and a negative $\Delta_r G^\circ$; values of zero mean the system is at equilibrium (शून्य होने पर तंत्र साम्यावस्था में होता है)
Yes, when high concentrations of non-ionic laundry detergent builders are added
No, because potential scales extensively with the total volume of electrodes
e: Explanation: For an electrochemical cell to be operational and feasible, $E^\circ_{\text{cell}}$ must be positive and $\Delta_r G^\circ$ must be negative. When $E_{\text{cell}} = \Delta_r G = 0$, the cell has reached chemical equilibrium and can no longer perform work.

qe: What does a negative standard reduction potential value like $E^\circ_{\text{Zn}^{2+}/\text{Zn}} = -0.76\text{ V}$ structurally signify about the reactivity of zinc?
qh: $E^\circ_{\text{Zn}^{2+}/\text{Zn}} = -0.76\text{ V}$ जैसा ऋणात्मक मानक अपचयन विभव मान संरचनात्मक रूप से जिंक की प्रतिक्रियाशीलता के बारे में क्या दर्शाता है?
o: Zinc is completely inert and acts as an excellent non-stick layer
Zinc undergoes reduction more easily than hydronium ions in solution
Zinc is more reactive than hydrogen, meaning it easily undergoes oxidation to act as an anode against a SHE (जिंक हाइड्रोजन से अधिक क्रियाशील है)
Zinc forms permanent shared-electron covalent links with passing amides
e: Explanation: A negative reduction potential ($-0.76\text{ V}$) relative to the standard hydrogen electrode ($0.00\text{ V}$) indicates that zinc is more reactive than hydrogen. It readily undergoes oxidation rather than reduction, acting as the anode when paired with a SHE.

qe: If separate aqueous solutions of copper sulfate ($\text{CuSO}_4$) and silver nitrate ($\text{AgNO}_3$) are electrolyzed using an identical 1 ampere current for 10 minutes, how will the deposited masses of copper and silver compare?
qh: यदि कॉपर सल्फेट ($\text{CuSO}_4$) और सिल्वर नाइट्रेट ($\text{AgNO}_3$) के अलग-अलग जलीय घोलों को 1 एम्पीयर की समान धारा का उपयोग करके 10 मिनट के लिए विद्युत अपघटित किया जाता है, तो जमा हुए तांबे और चांदी के द्रव्यमान की तुलना कैसे होगी?
o: The masses will be identical because the charge passed is exactly the same
Different masses will be deposited, proportional to their respective chemical equivalent weights (द्रव्यमान भिन्न होंगे, तुल्यांकी भार के समानुपाती)
No mass will plate out because the current applied is too low
The entire solution will convert into a volatile gas configuration
e: Explanation: According to Faraday's second law of electrolysis, when the same quantity of electricity is passed through different electrolytes, the masses of the liberated substances are directly proportional to their chemical equivalent weights ($E = \text{molar mass}/n$). Since $E_{\text{Cu}}$ ($63.5/2$) and $E_{\text{Ag}}$ ($108/1$) differ, the deposited masses will be different.

qe: Which structural notation accurately highlights the arrangement of components inside a Galvanic cell driving the reaction $\text{Cu} + 2\text{Ag}^+ \rightarrow 2\text{Ag} + \text{Cu}^{2+}$?
qh: कौन सा संरचनात्मक संकेतन प्रतिक्रिया $\text{Cu} + 2\text{Ag}^+ \rightarrow 2\text{Ag} + \text{Cu}^{2+}$ को चलाने वाले गैल्वेनिक सेल के भीतर घटकों की व्यवस्था को सटीक रूप से रेखांकित करता है?
o: $\text{Ag} \mid \text{Ag}^+ \parallel \text{Cu}^{2+} \mid \text{Cu}$
$\text{Cu} \mid \text{Cu}^{2+} \parallel \text{Ag}^+ \mid \text{Ag}$ (गैल्वेनिक सेल का सही संकेतन)
$\text{Cu}^{2+} \mid \text{Cu} \parallel \text{Ag} \mid \text{Ag}^+$
$\text{Cu} \mid \text{Ag}^+ \parallel \text{Cu}^{2+} \mid \text{Ag}$
e: Explanation: By electrochemical convention, the anode oxidation half-cell ($ ext{Cu} \mid \text{Cu}^{2+}$) is written on the left, the cathode reduction half-cell ($\text{Ag}^+ \mid \text{Ag}$) is written on the right, and the salt bridge is represented by parallel vertical lines ($\parallel$).

qe: What specific descriptor explains the potential difference established between a metallic solid electrode and its surrounding aqueous electrolyte solution?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट विवरण एक धातु ठोस इलेक्ट्रोड और उसके आसपास के जलीय इलेक्ट्रोलाइट समाधान के बीच स्थापित संभावित अंतर को समझाता है?
o: Molar conductivity constant
Electrode Potential (इलेक्ट्रोड विभव)
Standard cell EMF profile
Oligomeric resistance coefficient
e: Explanation: The potential difference developed at the interface between a metal electrode and its surrounding electrolytic solution due to charge separation is formally defined as the electrode potential.

qe: Why is an alternating current (AC) intentionally utilized instead of direct current (DC) when measuring the electrical resistance of an electrolytic solution?
qh: एक इलेक्ट्रोलाइटिक समाधान के विद्युत प्रतिरोध को मापते समय डायरेक्ट करंट (DC) के बजाय अल्टरनेटिंग करंट (AC) का जानबूझकर उपयोग क्यों किया जाता है?
o: To accelerate the common-ion precipitation of volatile metal halides
To keep the ion concentration constant near the electrodes and prevent polarization errors (ध्रुवण रोकना एवं सांद्रता स्थिर रखना)
To convert the solution into an unbranched biodegradable polyester network
To permanently lower the activation energy of the water solvent matrix
e: Explanation: Using a direct current (DC) causes continuous electrolysis, changing the local concentration of ions around the electrodes and causing polarization. Utilizing an alternating current (AC) reverses the current direction rapidly, keeping the composition stable and ensuring accurate resistance measurements.
