qe: How does the pH of a brine solution (aqueous $\text{NaCl}$) react when it is subjected to progressive industrial electrolysis processing?
qh: जब ब्राइन समाधान (जलीय $\text{NaCl}$) को प्रगतिशील औद्योगिक विद्युत अपघटन प्रसंस्करण के अधीन किया जाता है तो उसका pH कैसे प्रतिक्रिया करता है?
o: The pH drops sharply toward highly acidic values due to chlorine retention
The pH rises significantly because $\text{NaOH}$ is continuously synthesized within the cell matrix (pH का बढ़ना)
The pH remains completely locked at neutrality under all current inputs
The pH undergoes conversion into a volatile dicarboxylic acid factor
e: Explanation: Electrolyzing aqueous $NaCl$ yields hydrogen gas ($H_2$) at the cathode and chlorine gas ($Cl_2$) at the anode. Hydroxyl ions ($OH^-$) accumulate in the solution along with spectator $Na^+$ ions to form sodium hydroxide ($NaOH$), making the solution basic and raising the pH.

qe: Why does a commercial mercury cell display a remarkably constant cell potential throughout its functional operational lifespan, unlike a standard dry cell?
qh: एक व्यावसायिक मर्करी सेल अपने पूरे कार्यात्मक परिचालन जीवनकाल में एक उल्लेखनीय रूप से स्थिर सेल विभव क्यों प्रदर्शित करता है, जो कि एक मानक ड्राई सेल के विपरीत है?
o: It consists of highly volatile liquid polyolefins that expand under heat
The overall cell reaction does not involve any active ions in solution whose concentration can change during discharge (आयनों की सांद्रता में परिवर्तन न होना)
It contains a high structural concentration of toxic arsenic bridges
It undergoes spontaneous ring-opening cleavage when exposed to air
e: Explanation: The mercury cell maintains a stable potential of $1.35\text{ V}$ because its net chemical reaction ($Zn(Hg) + HgO(s) \rightarrow ZnO(s) + Hg(l)$) does not involve any dissolved ions whose concentrations fluctuate during discharge, keeping internal resistance stable.

qe: What macro-architectural layout characterizes a protein structure classified under the structural grouping of a globular protein like insulin?
qh: इंसुलिन जैसे ग्लोबुलर प्रोटीन के संरचनात्मक समूह के तहत वर्गीकृत प्रोटीन संरचना की क्या व्यापक-संरचनात्मक व्यवस्था विशेषता है?
o: Polypeptide strands running parallel to each other held by broad links
Polypeptide chains coiled and wrapped tightly into a compact spherical shape, rendering them water-soluble (गोलाकार आकृति एवं जल में घुलनशील)
Linear unbranched chains interacting via loose van der Waals fields
A cross-linked network layer centered around a quaternary ammonium center
e: Explanation: Globular proteins form when long polypeptide chains fold into compact, spherical shapes. This conformation places polar residues on the exterior, making them water-soluble, which distinguishes them from fibrous proteins.

qe: Which specific organic compound name represents the functional molecular structure of Vitamin B1?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक यौगिक नाम विटामिन बी1 की कार्यात्मक आणविक संरचना का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है?
o: Ascorbic acid entry
Thiamine (थायमीन)
Riboflavin framework
Pyridoxine complex
e: Explanation: Under international biochemical guidelines, the essential water-soluble molecule known as Vitamin $B_1$ is designated as thiamine.

qe: What direct pathological symptom indicates the onset of Scurvy caused by a severe deficiency of ascorbic acid (Vitamin C)?
qh: एस्कॉर्बिक एसिड (विटामिन सी) की गंभीर कमी के कारण होने वाले स्कर्वी (Scurvy) की शुरुआत का कौन सा प्रत्यक्ष लक्षण संकेत देता है?
o: Abnormal corneal xerophthalmia and visual drying errors
Bleeding gums and fragile vascular capillary boundaries (मसूड़ों से खून आना)
Soft malformation and structural bowing of long leg bones
Increased blood clotting time after minor mechanical cuts
e: Explanation: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) is a vital cofactor for collagen synthesis. A deficiency leads to scurvy, which weakens connective tissues and compromises blood vessel walls, characteristically presenting as bleeding gums.

qe: Which specialized biocatalyst enzyme governs the decomposition of urea into ammonia gas and carbon dioxide?
qh: कौन सा विशेष जैवउत्प्रेरक एंजाइम यूरिया के अमोनिया गैस और कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड में अपघटन (decomposition) को नियंत्रित करता है?
o: Invertase sugar clearing fluid
Urease (यूरिएस)
Maltase structural enzyme
Pepsin proteolytic catalyst
e: Explanation: Urease is a highly specific enzyme that catalyzes the hydrolytic breakdown of urea ($NH_2CONH_2$) into ammonia ($NH_3$) and carbon dioxide ($CO_2$).

qe: Which nitrogenous heterocyclic base is strictly exclusive to DNA strands, being replaced by uracil inside RNA?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट नाइट्रोजनयुक्त हेटरोसाइक्लिक बेस विशेष रूप से डीएनए (DNA) धागे के लिए विशिष्ट है, जिसे आरएनए के भीतर यूरेसिल द्वारा प्रतिस्थापित किया जाता है?
o: Adenine purine base
Thymine (थायमीन)
Guanine heterocyclic unit
Cytosine aromatic center
e: Explanation: DNA strings are structured around four heterocyclic bases: adenine, guanine, cytosine, and thymine. RNA uses a similar set but replaces thymine with uracil.

qe: What terminology defines a molecule formed when an organic nitrogenous base attaches covalently to the C1' position of a pentose sugar ring?
qh: उस अणु को क्या शब्दावली परिभाषित करती है जो तब बनता है जब एक कार्बनिक नाइट्रोजनयुक्त बेस एक पेंटोज शर्करा रिंग की C1' स्थिति से सहसंयोजक रूप से जुड़ता है?
o: Nucleoside (न्यूक्लिओसाइड)
Nucleotide monomer building block
Phosphodiester linkage complex
Zwitterion dipole grid
e: Explanation: Connecting a purine or pyrimidine base to the C1' carbon of ribose or deoxyribose produces a nucleoside. Once a phosphate group is attached to the 5' position of this sugar, it becomes a nucleotide.

qe: When two nucleotide blocks combine to construct a dinucleotide chain, which specific carbon centers along the pentose sugars house the phosphodiester bridge?
qh: जब दो न्यूक्लियोटाइड ब्लॉक एक डाइन्यूक्लियोटाइड श्रृंखला का निर्माण करने के लिए गठबंधन करते हैं, तो पेंटोज शर्करा के साथ कौन से विशिष्ट कार्बन केंद्र फॉस्फोडिएस्टर पुल को रखते हैं?
o: 5' and 3' carbon positions (5' तथा 3' कार्बन स्थान)
1' and 5' carbon positions
5' and 5' carbon locations
3' and 3' carbon targets
e: Explanation: Polynucleotide chains expand sequentially via step-growth condensation. The linking phosphate group forms a covalent phosphodiester linkage that connects the 5' carbon of one pentose ring to the 3' position of the adjacent sugar.

qe: Which specific organic functional group is generated when the carboxyl group of one amino acid condenses with the amino group of an adjacent unit to build a protein?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक कार्यात्मक समूह तब उत्पन्न होता है जब एक अमीनो एसिड का कार्बोक्सिल समूह प्रोटीन बनाने के लिए आसन्न इकाई के अमीनो समूह के साथ संघनित होता है?
o: Glycosidic connection bridging rings
Peptide linkage / Amide bond (पेप्टाइड बंध / एमाइड लिंक)
Phosphodiester coordinate bridge
Sulfur disulfide cross-link system
e: Explanation: Combining the alpha-carboxyl group of one amino acid with the alpha-amino center of another eliminates a water molecule, establishing a covalent amide linkage ($-CONH-$) termed a peptide bond or peptide linkage.

qe: What happens to the structure of the cyclic monomer caprolactam when it is heated with water to generate Nylon-6?
qh: जब चक्रीय मोनोमर कैप्रोलैक्टम को नायलॉन-6 उत्पन्न करने के लिए पानी के साथ गर्म किया जाता है तो उसकी संरचना का क्या होता है?
o: It cross-links into a three-dimensional network containing permanent methylene bridges
It undergoes hydrolytic ring-opening cleavage to yield an open amino acid chain that polymerizes into a polyamide (रिंग-ओपनिंग जलअपघटन)
It undergoes oxidation into a dibasic dicarboxylic acid fragment
It forms insoluble precipitates via the common-ion effect
e: Explanation: Heating caprolactam with water breaks its internal cyclic amide bond. This ring-opening hydrolytic step yields $\varepsilon$-aminocaproic acid, which polymerizes into the linear polyamide chain of Nylon-6.

qe: Which physical properties characteristically separate water-soluble globular proteins from water-insoluble fibrous options?
qh: कौन से भौतिक गुण पानी में घुलनशील ग्लोबुलर प्रोटीन को पानी में अघुलनशील रेशेदार विकल्पों से विशिष्ट रूप से अलग करते हैं?
o: Globular proteins are structured as long linear sheets held by coordinate ionic centers
Globular proteins form compact spherical shapes with polar groups on the exterior, rendering them water-soluble (गोलाकार आकृति एवं जल-घुलनशीलता)
Globular proteins turn completely volatile under normal room parameters
Globular proteins contain extensive networks of unbranched synthetic polyolefins
e: Explanation: Globular proteins fold into dense spherical configurations that expose hydrophilic residues to the surrounding environment, making them water-soluble. Fibrous proteins contain parallel strands locked by non-covalent forces, making them insoluble.

qe: What is the precise modern structural and chemical definition assigned to the macro-class of materials known as carbohydrates?
qh: कार्बोहाइड्रेट के रूप में जाने जाने वाले सामग्रियों के व्यापक वर्ग को दी गई सटीक आधुनिक संरचनात्मक और रासायनिक परिभाषा क्या है?
o: Optically inactive linear aromatic hydrocarbons with single bonds
Optically active polyhydroxy aldehydes or ketones, or compounds yielding them upon hydrolysis (पॉलीहाइड्रॉक्सी एल्डिहाइड या कीटोन)
Unbranched non-ionic long-chain potassium fatty acid salts
Suicidal competitive enzyme inhibitors with irreversible networks
e: Explanation: Modern biochemistry defines carbohydrates based on functional features: they are optically active polyhydroxy aldehydes or polyhydroxy ketones, or complex structures that break down into these subunits upon chemical hydrolysis.

qe: Which specific organic compound name represents the functional molecular structure of Vitamin B2?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक यौगिक नाम विटामिन बी2 की कार्यात्मक आणविक संरचना का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है?
o: Ascorbic acid configuration
Riboflavin (राइबोफ्लेविन)
Pyridoxine derivative complex
Thiamine hydrochloride group
e: Explanation: Riboflavin is the systematic chemical designation for Vitamin $B_2$. It is an essential cofactor required for coenzymes involved in cellular respiration and redox pathways.

qe: What direct pathological symptom outlines the onset of standard Cheilosis caused by a severe deficiency of riboflavin?
qh: रिबोफ्लेविन की गंभीर कमी के कारण होने वाले सामान्य कीलोसिस (Cheilosis) की शुरुआत का कौन सा प्रत्यक्ष लक्षण वर्णन करता है?
o: Severe night blindness accompanied by corneal drying anomalies
Localized cracking and fissuring at the corners of the mouth and lips (मुंह के कोनों और होंठों का फटना)
Abnormal soft malformation and bending of the long leg bones
Continuous bleeding from fragile vascular matrices near the gums
e: Explanation: Cheilosis is a clear diagnostic indicator of a Vitamin $B_2$ (riboflavin) deficiency. It presents as localized inflammation, painful fissures, and cracking at the corners of the mouth and lips.

qe: What happens to the structure of DNA during the replication cycle to ensure that two identical genetic libraries are created for daughter cells?
qh: डीएनए की संरचना में प्रतिकृति चक्र (replication cycle) के दौरान क्या होता है ताकि यह सुनिश्चित हो सके कि बेटी कोशिकाओं के लिए दो समान आनुवंशिक पुस्तकालय बनाए गए हैं?
o: The covalent phosphodiester backbones split into random open-chain carbohydrates
The double helix unwinds as inter-chain hydrogen bonds split, allowing each separate strand to act as a template for synthesizing a new complementary strand (डबल हेलिक्स का खुलना)
The entire macromolecule converts into a volatile network of non-ionic ethers
The nitrogenous bases undergo complete cross-linking with ambient proteins
e: Explanation: During replication, specific enzymes unzip the double helix by disrupting the hydrogen bonds between base pairs. The strands separate, and each acts as a template for building a new complementary strand matching the base rules.

qe: Solutions of two electrolytes, A and B, are progressively diluted. The molar conductivity ($\Lambda_m$) of 'B' expands by 1.5 times, while that of 'A' increases by 25 times. Which option correctly identifies the strong electrolyte?
qh: दो इलेक्ट्रोलाइट्स, A और B के समाधानों को उत्तरोत्तर तनु (diluted) किया जाता है। 'B' की मोलर चालकता ($\Lambda_m$) 1.5 गुना बढ़ जाती है, जबकि 'A' की 25 गुना बढ़ जाती है। कौन सा विकल्प मजबूत इलेक्ट्रोलाइट की सही पहचान करता है?
o: Electrolyte A, because its structural degree of dissociation increases dramatically

Electrolyte B, because strong electrolytes are already fully dissociated, and dilution merely reduces minor inter-ionic friction (इलेक्ट्रोलाइट B, क्योंकि मजबूत इलेक्ट्रोलाइट्स पहले से ही पूर्णतः वियोजित होते हैं)
Both behave as identical strong electrolytes under coordination rules
Neither is a strong electrolyte; both represent unstable linear polymers
e: Explanation: Strong electrolytes are already completely dissociated into ions even at high concentrations. When diluted, the total number of ions stays relatively constant, but the distance between them increases, minimizing inter-ionic attractions. This causes a minor increase in $\Lambda_m$ (e.g., 1.5 times for B). Weak electrolytes (like A) undergo a surge in ionization upon dilution, showing a drastic increase.

qe: When acidulated water containing a dilute solution of sulfuric acid ($H_2SO_4$) undergoes continuous electrolysis, how is the pH profile of the solution affected?
qh: जब सल्फ्यूरिक एसिड ($H_2SO_4$) के तनु विलयन युक्त अम्लीकृत पानी का निरंतर विद्युत अपघटन (electrolysis) किया जाता है, तो विलयन का pH प्रोफ़ाइल कैसे प्रभावित होता है?
o: The pH rises sharply toward basic parameters due to the loss of hydrogen
The pH remains completely constant because the total concentration of hydronium ions ($[H^+]$) remains unchanged (pH का अघुलनशील या स्थिर रहना)
The pH drops to absolute zero via spontaneous free-radical propagation
The solution converts into a highly cross-linked non-ionic polymer layer
e: Explanation: During the electrolysis of acidulated water, the oxidation of water at the anode liberates oxygen gas and generates $H^+$ ions ($2\text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{O}_2 + 4\text{H}^+ + 4e^-$). Simultaneously, the reduction of hydrogen ions at the cathode consumes $H^+$ ions to release hydrogen gas ($4\text{H}^+ + 4e^- \rightarrow 2\text{H}_2$). Because the generation and consumption rates of $H^+$ match, the net concentration remains constant, keeping the pH stable.

qe: What happens to the specific conductivity ($\kappa$) of an aqueous electrolyte solution when a significant volume of pure water is systematically added?
qh: जब एक जलीय इलेक्ट्रोलाइट विलयन में शुद्ध पानी की एक महत्वपूर्ण मात्रा को व्यवस्थित रूप से जोड़ा जाता है, तो उसकी विशिष्ट चालकता ($\kappa$) का क्या होता है?
o: The conductivity expands because ions are free to slide past one another
The conductivity decreases because the total number of current-carrying ions present per unit volume drops (तनुकरण करने पर विशिष्ट चालकता का घटना)
The conductivity is locked permanently at a constant index profile
The conductivity doubles via the common-ion precipitation of metal segments
e: Explanation: Specific conductivity ($\kappa$) is defined as the current-carrying capacity of a solution per unit volume. Adding water (dilution) expands the total volume of the solution, which reduces the total number of ions present within each cubic centimeter, causing specific conductivity to fall.

qe: Which standard reference electrode configuration has been assigned an absolute potential value of exactly zero volts to measure other half-cells?
qh: अन्य हाफ-सेलों को मापने के लिए किस मानक संदर्भ इलेक्ट्रोड (reference electrode) कॉन्फ़िगरेशन को बिल्कुल शून्य वोल्ट का पूर्ण संभावित मान सौंपा गया है?
o: The copper-copper sulfate half-cell system
The Standard Hydrogen Electrode (SHE / मानक हाइड्रोजन इलेक्ट्रोड)
The linear unbranched dicarboxylic acid framework
The cross-linked zinc resin lattice network layer
e: Explanation: The Standard Hydrogen Electrode (SHE) is universally utilized as the baseline reference electrode. Its standard reduction potential is assigned an arbitrary value of $0.00\text{ V}$ at all temperatures, allowing technicians to calibrate other half-cell systems relative to it.

qe: For an electrochemical cell characterized by the shorthand notation $\text{Cu} \mid \text{Cu}^{2+} \parallel \text{Cl}^- \mid \text{Cl}_2, \text{Pt}$, which specific half-reactions proceed at the anode and cathode respectively?
qh: $\text{Cu} \mid \text{Cu}^{2+} \parallel \text{Cl}^- \mid \text{Cl}_2, \text{Pt}$ द्वारा दर्शाए गए इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल सेल के लिए, क्रमशः एनोड और कैथोड पर कौन सी विशिष्ट हाफ-प्रतिक्रियाएं आगे बढ़ती हैं?
o: $	ext{Anode: } 	ext{Cl}_2 + 2e^- \rightarrow 2	ext{Cl}^- ; \, 	ext{Cathode: } 	ext{Cu} \rightarrow 	ext{Cu}^{2+} + 2e^-$
$	ext{Anode: } 	ext{Cu} \rightarrow 	ext{Cu}^{2+} + 2e^- ; \, 	ext{Cathode: } 	ext{Cl}_2 + 2e^- \rightarrow 2	ext{Cl}^-$ (एनोड एवं कैथोड हाफ-अभिक्रियाएं)
$	ext{Anode: } 2	ext{H}_2	ext{O} \rightarrow 	ext{O}_2 + 4	ext{H}^+ + 4e^- ; \, 	ext{Cathode: } 	ext{Na}^+ + e^- \rightarrow 	ext{Na}$
$	ext{Anode: } 	ext{Cu} + 	ext{Cl}_2 \rightarrow 	ext{Cu}^{2+} + 2	ext{Cl}^- ; \, 	ext{Cathode: } 0\text{ V}$
e: Explanation: In a standard cell representation, the left hand side tracks the anode compartment where oxidation occurs: $\text{Cu}(s) \rightarrow \text{Cu}^{2+}(aq) + 2e^-$. The right hand side tracks the cathode where reduction takes place: \text{Cl}_2(g) + 2e^- \rightarrow 2\text{Cl}^-(aq).

qe: Based on the Nernst equation for a Daniell cell, $E_{\text{cell}} = E^\circ_{\text{cell}} - \frac{0.0591}{2}\log\frac{[\text{Zn}^{2+}]}{[\text{Cu}^{2+}]}$, what happens to the output potential if the concentration of zinc ions is systematically increased?
qh: डेनियल सेल के नर्स्ट समीकरण $E_{\text{cell}} = E^\circ_{\text{cell}} - \frac{0.0591}{2}\log\frac{[\text{Zn}^{2+}]}{[\text{Cu}^{2+}]}$ के आधार पर, यदि जिंक आयनों की सांद्रता को व्यवस्थित रूप से बढ़ाया जाए तो आउटपुट विभव का क्या होता है?
o: The value of $E_{\text{cell}}$ expands linearly because zinc acts as a mechanical stabilizer
The value of $E_{\text{cell}}$ decreases because the cell potential is inversely proportional to the log ratio of product ions ($E_{\text{cell}}$ का घटना)
The value of $E_{\text{cell}}$ drops instantly to zero absolute volts
The value of $E_{\text{cell}}$ converts into an extensive property independent of log factors
e: Explanation: The Nernst equation shows that $E_{\text{cell}}$ is directly proportional to $\log[\text{Cu}^{2+}]$ and inversely proportional to $\log[\text{Zn}^{2+}]$. Increasing the product ion concentration ($[\text{Zn}^{2+}]$) increases the subtracted logarithmic term, which directly decreases the dynamic cell potential ($E_{\text{cell}}$).

qe: What primary operational advantage do continuous fuel cells maintain over traditional secondary and primary battery designs?
qh: पारंपरिक सेकेंडरी और प्राइमरी बैटरी डिज़ाइनों की तुलना में निरंतर चलने वाले ईंधन सेल (fuel cells) क्या प्राथमिक परिचालन लाभ बनाए रखते हैं?
o: They can store infinite electrical charge internally without any liquid solution
They run continuously without degradation as long as reactant fuels are steadily supplied and products are cleared (ईंधन सेल का निरंतर कार्य करना)
They utilize cross-linked phenolic resin networks to avoid temperature variations
They operate strictly under free-radical coordination mechanism constraints
e: Explanation: Primary batteries have a limited fuel capacity and expire when depleted, while secondary batteries require hours to recharge. Fuel cells run continuously as long as external reactants (like hydrogen and oxygen) are supplied to the electrodes and byproducts are cleared systematically.

qe: What net chemical reaction details the discharge process of a standard lead storage battery, and how does the density of its electrolyte change?
qh: एक मानक लेड स्टोरेज बैटरी के डिस्चार्ज होने की प्रक्रिया का क्या नेट रासायनिक अभिक्रिया विवरण है, और इसके इलेक्ट्रोलाइट का घनत्व कैसे बदलता है?
o: $\text{Pb} + \text{SO}_4^{2-} \rightarrow \text{PbSO}_4$; density increases due to precipitation
$\text{Pb} + \text{PbO}_2 + 2\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4 \rightarrow 2\text{PbSO}_4 + 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$; density decreases as sulfuric acid is consumed and water forms (घनत्व का घटना)
$\text{PbO}_2 + 4\text{H}^+ \rightarrow \text{Pb}^{2+} + 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$; density stays locked at unity
$\text{PbSO}_4 + 2e^- \rightarrow \text{Pb}$; density converts into a volatile extensive property
e: Explanation: During discharge, the battery consumes sulfuric acid ($H_2SO_4$) and produces water ($H_2O$) alongside solid $\text{PbSO}_4$. Because dense acid is replaced by less dense water, the overall density of the electrolyte decreases significantly.

qe: Why does the molar conductivity ($\Lambda_m$) of acetic acid ($	ext{CH}_3	ext{COOH}$) increase drastically upon progressive dilution, whereas that of sodium acetate ($	ext{CH}_3	ext{COONa}$) expands only gradually?
qh: प्रगतिशील तनुकरण (progressive dilution) करने पर एसिटिक एसिड ($	ext{CH}_3	ext{COOH}$) की मोलर चालकता ($\Lambda_m$) अत्यधिक क्यों बढ़ जाती है, जबकि सोडियम एसीटेट ($	ext{CH}_3	ext{COONa}$) की केवल धीरे-धीरे बढ़ती है?
o: Acetic acid is a strong electrolyte that undergoes rapid structural cross-linking

Acetic acid is a weak electrolyte whose degree of dissociation surges upon dilution, generating a higher number of ions, whereas strong sodium acetate merely experiences a drop in inter-ionic friction (दुर्बल इलेक्ट्रोलाइट में वियोजन की मात्रा का बढ़ना)
Sodium acetate converts completely into a volatile open-chain gas cloud configuration
BothUtilize identical linear coordination mechanisms that fail in hard water profiles
e: Explanation: Acetic acid is a weak electrolyte that is only partially ionized at standard concentrations. Diluting the solution shifts the equilibrium, causing a surge in its degree of dissociation (Ostwald's dilution law) and sharply increasing the total number of ions. Sodium acetate is a strong electrolyte that is already fully ionized; dilution merely reduces inter-ionic friction.

qe: Which specific unit combo corresponds to the systematic physical measurement of the cell constant ($G^*$) in metric configurations?
qh: मीट्रिक विन्यासों में कौन सा विशिष्ट इकाई कॉम्बो सेल स्थिरांक ($G^*$) के व्यवस्थित भौतिक माप से मेल खाता है?
o: $\text{S}\cdot\text{cm}^2\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}$
$\text{m}^{-1}$ or $\text{cm}^{-1}$ (सेल स्थिरांक की इकाई)
$\text{S}\cdot\text{cm}^{-1}$
Volt ($\text{V}$)
e: Explanation: The cell constant ($G^*$) represents the geometric ratio of electrode separation length ($\ell$) to cross-sectional area ($A$). Calculating this ratio ($ ext{cm}/ ext{cm}^2$) yields the standard inverse length units: $ ext{cm}^{-1}$ or $ ext{m}^{-1}$.

qe: Which SI unit designation is universally utilized to report the magnitude of standard specific conductivity ($\kappa$)?
qh: मानक विशिष्ट चालकता ($\kappa$) के परिमाण को सूचित करने के लिए कौन सी SI इकाई सार्वभौमिक रूप से उपयोग की जाती है?
o: $\text{S}\cdot\text{cm}^2\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}$
$\text{S}\cdot\text{m}^{-1}$ or $\text{S}\cdot\text{cm}^{-1}$ (विशिष्ट चालकता की इकाई)
$\text{V}$
e: Explanation: Specific conductivity ($\kappa$) represents conductance per unit volume. Reported in inverse ohm inverse length units, its standard metrics are expressed as $\text{S}\cdot\text{cm}^{-1}$ or $\text{S}\cdot\text{m}^{-1}$.

qe: How are the standard cell potential ($E^\circ_{\text{cell}}$) and specific conductivity ($\kappa$) categorized based on thermodynamic scales of property behavior?
qh: थर्मोडायनामिक व्यवहार के आधार पर मानक सेल विभव ($E^\circ_{\text{cell}}$) और विशिष्ट चालकता ($\kappa$) को कैसे वर्गीकृत किया जाता है?
o: Both function as extensive thermodynamic parameters scaling with substance volume
Both function as intensive properties because their electrical profiles do not scale with the bulk mass or total volume of the system (गहन गुण होना)
Both turn highly basic with an automated pH tracking toward 14
Both transform into extensive parameters when paired with a salt bridge framework
e: Explanation: Both $E^\circ_{\text{cell}}$ and specific conductivity ($\kappa$) are intensive properties. Their localized values are determined purely by chemical composition and temperature, remaining entirely independent of the bulk size or scale of the system.

qe: Which material pair correctly matches an active electrode with its primary structural composition inside a commercial lead storage battery?
qh: कौन सी सामग्री जोड़ी एक व्यावसायिक लेड स्टोरेज बैटरी के भीतर एक सक्रिय इलेक्ट्रोड को उसकी प्राथमिक संरचनात्मक संरचना से सही ढंग से मेल खाती है?
o: Anode is solid cadmium; Cathode is nickel oxide matrix
Anode is metallic sponge lead ($	ext{Pb}$); Cathode is a grid of lead dioxide ($	ext{PbO}_2$) (Pb एनोड तथा PbO2 कैथोड)
Anode is a linear Novolac strand; Cathode is cross-linked Bakelite
Anode is a platinum black sheet; Cathode is an open-chain starch segment
e: Explanation: A standard commercial lead storage battery employs spongy lead metal ($ ext{Pb}$) as the active negative electrode (anode) and a structural grid packed with lead dioxide ($ ext{PbO}_2$) as the active positive electrode (cathode).

qe: Why can an industrial mercury cell deliver a remarkably steady cell potential throughout its functional operating life, unlike traditional dry cells?
qh: एक औद्योगिक मर्करी सेल अपने पूरे कार्यात्मक परिचालन जीवन में एक उल्लेखनीय रूप से स्थिर सेल विभव क्यों दे सकता है, जो कि पारंपरिक ड्राई सेलों के विपरीत है?
o: It contains highly volatile polyolefin tail fragments that expand under heat
The net cell reaction does not involve any active ions in solution whose concentration can change during discharge (आयनों की सांद्रता में परिवर्तन न होना)
It incorporates extensive networks of cross-linked synthetic polyamides
It relies exclusively on loose glycosidic links to stabilize its current profile
e: Explanation: The mercury cell provides a constant potential of $1.35\text{ V}$ because its overall chemical reaction ($Zn(Hg) + HgO(s) \rightarrow ZnO(s) + Hg(l)$) consists entirely of solid and liquid phases. Because it involves no dissolved ions whose concentrations fluctuate during discharge, internal resistance stays locked.

qe: Which specific algebraic formula correctly defines the operational value of specific conductivity ($\kappa$) from cell constant ($G^*$) and resistance ($R$)?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट बीजगणितीय सूत्र सेल स्थिरांक ($G^*$) और प्रतिरोध ($R$) से विशिष्ट चालकता ($\kappa$) के परिचालन मान को सही ढंग से परिभाषित करता है?
o: $\kappa = R \cdot G^*$
$\kappa = \frac{G^*}{R}$ (चालकता एवं सेल स्थिरांक सूत्र)
$\kappa = \Lambda_m \cdot C$
$\kappa = \frac{R}{G^*}$
e: Explanation: Specific conductivity ($\kappa$) measures current-carrying throughput per unit volume. It is defined mathematically as the ratio of the fixed cell constant ($G^*$) to the measured electrical resistance ($R$): $\kappa = G^*/R$.

qe: What terminology defines the maximum limiting value of molar conductivity achieved when an electrolyte solution undergoes progressive dilution toward zero concentration?
qh: जब एक इलेक्ट्रोलाइट विलयन शून्य सांद्रता की ओर प्रगतिशील तनुकरण से गुजरता है तो प्राप्त मोलर चालकता के अधिकतम सीमित मान को कौन सा नामकरण शब्द परिभाषित करता है?
o: Anomeric intermediate potential
Limiting Molar Conductivity (अनंत तनुता पर मोलर चालकता - \Lambda_m^\circ)
Unbranched non-ionic resistance factor
Cross-linked network alignment index
e: Explanation: When an electrolyte solution is heavily diluted to an infinite degree, concentration approaches zero. The molar conductivity plateaus at its maximum structural boundary value, termed the Limiting Molar Conductivity ($\Lambda_m^\circ$).

qe: What quantitative variable allows electrochemists to express the electrical charge ($Q$) passed through a cell in terms of steady state current ($I$) and time ($t$)?
qh: कौन सा मात्रात्मक चर (quantitative variable) इलेक्ट्रोकेमिस्ट को स्थिर अवस्था धारा ($I$) और समय ($t$) के संदर्भ में एक सेल के माध्यम से पारित विद्युत आवेश ($Q$) को व्यक्त करने की अनुमति देता है?
o: $Q = \frac{I}{t}$
$Q = I \cdot t$ (विद्युत आवेश सूत्र)
$Q = \frac{\Lambda_m}{\Lambda_m^\circ}$
$Q = nF E^\circ$
e: Explanation: The total quantity of electrical charge ($Q$, measured in Coulombs) traveling through an electrolytic cell is directly calculated by multiplying the current intensity ($I$, in Amperes) by the operational time duration ($t$, in seconds): $Q = I \cdot t$.

qe: Which commercial battery design is explicitly classified as a rechargeable secondary battery with an extensive operating lifetime?
qh: किस व्यावसायिक बैटरी डिज़ाइन को स्पष्ट रूप से एक विस्तृत परिचालन जीवनकाल के साथ एक रिचार्जेबल सेकेंडरी बैटरी (rechargeable secondary battery) के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
o: Leclanche dry cell
Nickel-Cadmium (Ni-Cd) cell (निकेल-कैडमियम सेल)
Mercury button cell
Hydrogen-oxygen fuel cell matrix
e: Explanation: The Nickel-Cadmium (Ni-Cd) battery is a popular secondary cell configuration. Unlike primary dry cells, its solid electrochemical products adhere to the plates, allowing the cell to undergo hundreds of reversible recharging cycles safely.

qe: Based on standard reduction data: $E^\circ_{\text{F}_2/\text{F}^-} = 2.87\text{ V}$ and $E^\circ_{\text{Li}^+/\text{Li}} = -3.05\text{ V}$. Which statement highlights the chemical nature of fluorine gas ($F_2$)?
qh: मानक अपचयन डेटा के आधार पर: $E^\circ_{\text{F}_2/\text{F}^-} = 2.87\text{ V}$ और $E^\circ_{\text{Li}^+/\text{Li}} = -3.05\text{ V}$। कौन सा कथन फ्लोरीन गैस ($F_2$) की रासायनिक प्रकृति पर प्रकाश डालता है?
o: It is a metal acting as the strongest reducing agent
It is a non-metal functioning as the best oxidizing agent due to its highly positive reduction potential (सबसे मजबूत ऑक्सीकरण एजेंट होना)
It behaves as a weak, non-competitive irreversible suicide inhibitor
It lacks electronegative elements across its molecular domains
e: Explanation: Fluorine gas ($F_2$) features an exceptionally large positive standard reduction potential ($2.87\text{ V}$). This indicates an extreme thermodynamic tendency to capture electrons and undergo reduction, classifying it as the best oxidizing agent in the series.

qe: Using the potential references: $E^\circ_{\text{Au}^{3+}/\text{Au}} = 1.40\text{ V}$ and $E^\circ_{\text{Br}_2/\text{Br}^-} = 1.09\text{ V}$. Why can an aqueous solution of gold ions ($\text{Au}^{3+}$) successfully oxidize bromide anions ($\text{Br}^-$)?
qh: संभावित संदर्भों का उपयोग करते हुए: $E^\circ_{\text{Au}^{3+}/\text{Au}} = 1.40\text{ V}$ और $E^\circ_{\text{Br}_2/\text{Br}^-} = 1.09\text{ V}$। सोने के आयनों ($\text{Au}^{3+}$) का एक जलीय घोल ब्रोमाइड अनियनों ($\text{Br}^-$) को सफलतापूर्वक क्यों ऑक्सीकृत कर सकता है?
o: Because bromide ions turn highly volatile when exposed to gold metal

Because the reduction potential of the gold couple is more positive than that of the bromine couple, making the net cell potential positive ($E^\circ_{\text{Au}^{3+}/\text{Au}} > E^\circ_{\text{Br}_2/\text{Br}^-}$) (सोने का विभव ब्रोमीन से अधिक होना)
Because gold represents a highly reactive linear dicarboxylic polymer
Because the reaction triggers immediate common-ion precipitation parameters
e: Explanation: A redox reaction is thermodynamically spontaneous when the cell potential is positive ($E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = E^\circ_{\text{cathode}} - E^\circ_{\text{anode}} > 0$). Since $E^\circ_{\text{Au}^{3+}/\text{Au}}$ ($1.40\text{ V}$) is larger than $E^\circ_{\text{Br}_2/\text{Br}^-}$ ($1.09\text{ V}$), $\text{Au}^{3+}$ can act as the cathode to spontaneously oxidize $\text{Br}^-$ into $\text{Br}_2$.

qe: Why can metallic copper not displace hydrogen gas ($H_2$) when added to an aqueous mineral acid solution under standard conditions?
qh: मानक परिस्थितियों में जलीय खनिज अम्ल विलयन में मिलाने पर धात्विक तांबा हाइड्रोजन गैस ($H_2$) को क्यों विस्थापित नहीं कर सकता?
o: Because copper dissolves into volatile open-chain sulfate gases instantly
Because its standard reduction potential is positive ($+0.34\text{ V}$), meaning it is less reactive than hydrogen and resists losing electrons to hydronium ions (तांबे का अपचयन विभव धनात्मक होना)
Because copper forms a highly stable cyclic pyranose structure with acid
Because it acts as a primary free-radical peroxide chain terminator step
e: Explanation: Copper features a positive standard reduction potential ($E^\circ_{\text{Cu}^{2+}/\text{Cu}} = +0.34\text{ V}$), which is higher than the standard hydrogen electrode ($0.00\text{ V}$). This means metallic copper is a weaker reducing agent than $H_2$ gas and cannot reduce $H^+$ ions into hydrogen gas.

qe: What specific criterion must the net cell potential ($E_{\text{cell}}$) satisfy to guarantee that an electrochemical cell circuit can spontaneously operate and perform work?
qh: एक इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल सेल सर्किट स्वतः काम कर सके और कार्य कर सके, इसके लिए नेट सेल विभव ($E_{\text{cell}}$) को किस विशिष्ट मानदंड को पूरा करना चाहिए?
o: It must be kept at a perfectly negative coordinate boundary indicator
It must maintain a positive voltage value ($E_{\text{cell}} > 0$), ensuring a negative Gibbs free energy change (धनात्मक वोल्टेज मान होना)
It must match the exact resistance of the linear non-ionic polymer layer
It must drop to absolute zero when mass action conditions expand
e: Explanation: For a cell to function spontaneously, the Gibbs free energy change must be thermodynamically negative ($\Delta G < 0$). According to the foundational relationship $\Delta G = -nFE_{\text{cell}}$, a negative $\Delta G$ is achieved only when the cell potential value is strictly positive ($E_{\text{cell}} > 0$).

qe: What physical parameter dictates why the limiting molar conductivity of a weak electrolyte expands sharply upon progressive dilution towards zero concentration?
qh: कौन सा भौतिक पैरामीटर यह निर्देशित करता है कि शून्य सांद्रता की ओर प्रगतिशील तनुकरण करने पर एक कमजोर इलेक्ट्रोलाइट की सीमित मोलर चालकता तेजी से क्यों बढ़ती है?
o: The polymer strands undergo direct cross-linking via methylene bridges
The degree of dissociation expands significantly, releasing a high volume of new ions into the solution matrix (वियोजन की मात्रा का बढ़ना)
The solution enters a stable crystalline phase locked by amide bonds
The specific conductivity factor experiences a spontaneous doubling effect
e: Explanation: Weak electrolytes are poorly ionized at standard concentrations. According to Ostwald's dilution law, lower concentrations shift the equilibrium, driving an increase in the degree of dissociation ($\alpha$). This release of new current-carrying ions causes a sharp increase in molar conductivity.

qe: What terminology defines a commercial cell designed specifically to convert the chemical energy generated from burning fuel resources directly into electrical current?
qh: कौन सी शब्दावली एक व्यावसायिक सेल को परिभाषित करती है जिसे विशेष रूप से ईंधन संसाधनों को जलाने से उत्पन्न रासायनिक ऊर्जा को सीधे विद्युत प्रवाह में बदलने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है?
o: Leclanche dry cell cluster
Fuel Cell (ईंधन सेल)
Nickel-Cadmium rechargeable bar
Mercury button battery system
e: Explanation: Fuel cells are specialized galvanic systems engineered to continuously transform the chemical energy derived from the combustion of fuels (such as hydrogen, methane, or methanol) directly into clean electrical energy.

qe: Which specific organic product represents the linear intermediate compound generated during the initial reaction of phenol and formaldehyde?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक उत्पाद फिनोल और फॉर्मलाडेहाइड की प्रारंभिक प्रतिक्रिया के दौरान उत्पन्न रैखिक मध्यवर्ती यौगिक (linear intermediate compound) का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है?
o: Bakelite network block
Novolac (नोवोलेक)
Caprolactam cyclic ring
Buna-N synthetic mesh
e: Explanation: Condensing phenol with formaldehyde initially builds a linear polymer chain resin known as Novolac. When Novolac is isolated and heated with excess formaldehyde, it undergoes cross-linking to produce the rigid thermosetting structure Bakelite.

qe: What architectural layout details the spatial arrangement of the repeating isoprene units inside a pristine sample of natural rubber?
qh: कौन सा संरचनात्मक लेआउट प्राकृतिक रबर के एक प्राचीन नमूने के भीतर आवर्ती आइसोप्रीन इकाइयों की स्थानिक व्यवस्था का विवरण देता है?
o: All-trans-1,4-polyisoprene network geometry
All-cis-1,4-polyisoprene linear homopolymer architecture (Cis-पॉलीआइसोप्रीन संरचना)
Cross-linked urea-formaldehyde thermosetting layout
Unbranched biodegradable polyhydroxybutyrate polyester chain
e: Explanation: Natural rubber is chemically defined as a linear homopolymer of isoprene arranged in an all-cis-1,4-polyisoprene geometry. This spatial configuration creates curved, coiled structures that interact via weak van der Waals forces, providing high elasticity.

qe: The industrial ring-opening polymerization of the cyclic amide monomer caprolactam at high temperatures yields which high-tensile poly-amide material?
qh: उच्च तापमान पर चक्रीय एमाइड मोनोमर कैप्रोलैक्टम का औद्योगिक रिंग-ओपनिंग पॉलीमराइजेशन किस उच्च-तन्यता वाले पॉली-एमाइड सामग्री को उत्पन्न करता है?
o: Nylon-6,6 fiber blocks
Nylon-6 poly-amide (नायलॉन-6)
Melamine formal breakproof resin
Buna-S synthetic addition rubber
e: Explanation: Heating the seven-membered cyclic lactam caprolactam with water drives a ring-opening polymerization process, aligning the fragments into a linear polyamide chain known as Nylon-6.

qe: The addition copolymer known as Buna-N is industrially compiled using which specific monomer ratio combo?
qh: ब्यूना-एन के रूप में जाने जाने वाले एडिशन कोपोलिमर को औद्योगिक रूप से किस विशिष्ट मोनोमर अनुपात कॉम्बो का उपयोग करके संकलित किया जाता है?
o: 50% Styrene and 50% caprolactam fluid fractions
75% 1,3-Butadiene and 25% Acrylonitrile (75% ब्यूटाडाइन एवं 25% एक्रिलोनाइट्राइल)
10% Phenol crystals and 90% formaldehyde gas
90% Ethylene glycol and 10% terephthalic acid
e: Explanation: Buna-N rubber is synthesized via the emulsion copolymerization of 1,3-butadiene and acrylonitrile, typically configured in an approximate 3:1 ratio (75% butadiene and 25% acrylonitrile).

qe: Which specific category of synthetic surfactants features a positively charged quaternary ammonium nitrogen center, making them ideal for commercial hair conditioners?
qh: सिंथेटिक सर्फेक्टेंट की किस विशिष्ट श्रेणी में सकारात्मक रूप से चार्ज किया गया क्वाटरनरी अमोनियम नाइट्रोजन केंद्र होता है, जो उन्हें व्यावसायिक हेयर कंडीशनर के लिए आदर्श बनाता है?
o: Anionic laundry detergent with a sulfonate head
Cationic detergent (Cationic सर्फेक्टेंट)
Non-ionic polyoxyethylene glycol ester
Traditional carboxylate soap block
e: Explanation: Cationic detergents are characterized by a polar head group carrying a permanent positive charge centered around a quaternary ammonium nitrogen atom. This configuration allows them to bind effectively to negatively charged hair strands, neutralizing static charges.

qe: Why can an over-reliance on traditional non-biodegradable synthetic plastics like polyethylene and polystyrene create systemic solid waste crises in urban ecosystems?
qh: पॉलीथीन और पॉलीस्टायरीइन जैसे पारंपरिक गैर-बायोडिग्रेडेबल सिंथेटिक प्लास्टिक पर अत्यधिक निर्भरता शहरी पारिस्थितिक तंत्र में प्रणालीगत ठोस अपशिष्ट संकट क्यों पैदा कर सकती है?
o: They undergo chemical conversion into volatile liquid alcohols within days
Their stable carbon-carbon backbones resist bacterial enzymatic cleavage, causing the discarded materials to persist indefinitely in landfills and waterways (अपघटन के प्रति प्रतिरोधी होना)
They hyper-saturate local soil matrixes with concentrated ammonia fumes
They automatically trigger the permanent covalent blocking of all biological receptors
e: Explanation: Traditional synthetic plastics possess highly stable carbon-carbon covalent backbones. Because common soil micro-organisms lack specific metabolic enzymes required to cleave these robust linkages, these discarded materials resist natural decomposition and accumulate indefinitely.

qe: Why does the industrial electrolysis of a concentrated brine solution ($	ext{NaCl}$) favor the release of chlorine gas ($Cl_2$) at the anode over oxygen gas ($O_2$), despite water having a lower standard potential requirement?
qh: सांद्र नमक के घोल ($	ext{NaCl}$) का औद्योगिक विद्युत अपघटन (electrolysis) पानी की तुलना में एनोड पर क्लोरीन गैस ($Cl_2$) के निकलने को क्यों प्राथमिकता देता है, जबकि पानी का मानक विभव कम होता है?
o: Because chlorine atoms are completely insoluble in aqueous mediums
Because water oxidation is kinetically sluggish and requires a substantial overpotential value to proceed (ऑक्सीजन निर्माण के लिए ओवर-पोटेंशियल की आवश्यकता)
Because the reaction triggers immediate common-ion precipitation of all materials
Because it causes the spontaneous degradation of the matching salt bridge gel
e: Explanation: Thermodynamically, water oxidation requires less potential ($1.23 ext{ V}$) than chloride oxidation ($1.36 ext{ V}$). However, the kinetics of oxygen evolution are highly sluggish, creating a structural voltage barrier known as overpotential or overvoltage. This suppresses water breakdown, causing chloride ions to selectively oxidize into chlorine gas.

qe: Why must an alternating current (AC) power source be deliberately utilized when measuring the electrical resistance of an ionic solution?
qh: एक आयनिक विलयन के विद्युत प्रतिरोध को मापते समय अल्टरनेटिंग करंट (AC) पावर स्रोत का जानबूझकर उपयोग क्यों किया जाना चाहिए?
o: To accelerate the common-ion precipitation of volatile metal halides
To keep the ion concentration uniform and prevent polarization errors that occur with a DC source (सांद्रता को स्थिर रखना तथा ध्रुवण रोकना)
To convert the solution into an unbranched biodegradable polyester network
To lower the activation energy of the water solvent matrix
e: Explanation: Using a direct current (DC) source drives continuous electrolysis, which rapidly alters the local chemical concentration of ions near the electrode surfaces and polarizes the cell. An alternating current (AC) source constantly reverses direction, keeping the solution composition uniform and stable for accurate resistance profiling.

qe: What physical parameter status marks the exact boundary condition where electrical current stops flowing through an active Galvanic cell circuit?
qh: कौन सी भौतिक पैरामीटर स्थिति उस सटीक सीमा स्थिति को चिह्नित करती है जहां एक सक्रिय गैल्वेनिक सेल सर्किट के माध्यम से विद्युत धारा का प्रवाह रुक जाता है?
o: The standard cell potential ($E^\circ_{	ext{cell}}$) drops precisely to zero volts
The dynamic cell potential ($E_{	ext{cell}}$) drops to exactly zero volts as chemical equilibrium is reached ($E_{cell} = 0$ होने पर साम्यावस्था स्थापित होना)
The resistance of the salt bridge matrix climbs to absolute infinity
The total entropy of the surrounding buffer drops to zero
e: Explanation: As a Galvanic cell operates, the reacting species continuously shift toward a state of chemical equilibrium. Once absolute chemical equilibrium is achieved, the overall cell potential ($E_{ ext{cell}}$) drops to exactly $0 ext{ V}$, meaning no net potential difference exists to drive an electron stream, halting the current flow.

qe: The Nernst equation for a silver half-cell is expressed as $E = E^\circ + 0.0591\log[	ext{Ag}^+]$. Based on this mathematical relationship, how does the reduction potential react if the silver ion concentration is systematically expanded?
qh: सिल्वर हाफ-सेल के लिए नर्स्ट समीकरण $E = E^\circ + 0.0591\log[	ext{Ag}^+]$ है। इस गणितीय संबंध के आधार पर, यदि सिल्वर आयन सांद्रता को व्यवस्थित रूप से बढ़ाया जाए तो अपचयन विभव (reduction potential) कैसे प्रतिक्रिया करता है?
o: The potential decreases linearly because of volume constraints
The potential increases directly because it is positively proportional to the logarithm of silver ion concentration (सिल्वर आयन सांद्रता बढ़ने पर विभव का बढ़ना)
The potential drops instantly to zero absolute volts
The potential switches signs from positive to negative values
e: Explanation: The Nernst equation for the silver couple ($E_{ ext{Ag}^+/ ext{Ag}} = E^\circ_{ ext{Ag}^+/ ext{Ag}} + 0.0591\log[ ext{Ag}^+]$) shows a directly proportional relationship between the dynamic potential and the logarithm of the silver ion concentration. Consequently, raising $[\text{Ag}^+]$ expands the logarithmic term, systematically increasing the electrode potential value.

qe: Why can an aqueous copper sulfate solution ($\text{CuSO}_4$) absolutely not be safely stored inside a container fabricated from solid zinc metal sheets?
qh: कॉपर सल्फेट ($\text{CuSO}_4$) के जलीय विलयन को ठोस जिंक धातु की चादरों से बने कंटेनर के भीतर सुरक्षित रूप से क्यों नहीं रखा जा सकता है?
o: Because copper sulfate evaporates into volatile sulfur dioxide gas upon contact with zinc
Because zinc possesses a negative standard reduction potential making it more reactive than copper, leading to a spontaneous displacement reaction (जिंक कॉपर से अधिक क्रियाशील है)
Because zinc forms an intricate non-ionic furanose sugar matrix with the solution
Because the setup initiates immediate structural denaturation of the container wall amides
e: Explanation: Zinc has a negative standard reduction potential ($-0.76 ext{ V}$) compared to copper ($+0.34 ext{ V}$), meaning it is more reactive and oxidizes more easily. Storing $ ext{CuSO}_4$ in a zinc vessel triggers a spontaneous single-displacement reaction where zinc dissolves into the solution as $ ext{Zn}^{2+}$ and copper plates out, destroying the container.

qe: Consider a setup where two cells are coupled together: Cell 'A' is an electrochemical cell with an EMF of 2.0 V, and Cell 'B' is a Daniell cell with a potential of 1.1 V. Which cell will be forced to operate as an electrolytic cell, and what reaction occurs at its anode?
qh: एक सेटअप पर विचार करें जहां दो सेलों को एक साथ जोड़ा गया है: सेल 'A' 2.0 V के EMF वाला एक इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल सेल है, और सेल 'B' 1.1 V के विभव वाला एक डेनियल सेल है। कौन सा सेल इलेक्ट्रोलाइटिक सेल के रूप में कार्य करने के लिए मजबूर होगा, और इसके एनोड पर क्या प्रतिक्रिया होगी?
o: Cell A; Zinc undergoes rapid reduction to metallic sheets
Cell B; Copper metal undergoes oxidation to dissolve as $\text{Cu}^{2+}$ ions (सेल B इलेक्ट्रोलाइटिक सेल की तरह कार्य करेगा तथा कॉपर का ऑक्सीकरण होगा)
Cell A; Liquid water splits into volatile open-chain non-polar gases
Cell B; Sulfate ions are converted into linear Novolac strings
e: Explanation: Because Cell 'A' delivers a higher opposing voltage ($2.0 ext{ V}$) than the native potential of the Daniell cell 'B' ($1.1 ext{ V}$), it drives current backward through Cell 'B'. This forces Cell 'B' to function as an electrolytic cell, reversing its natural half-reactions so that copper metal undergoes oxidation at the anode: $ ext{Cu}(s) ightarrow ext{Cu}^{2+} + 2e^-$.

qe: If a coupled cell system features a lower opposing voltage from Cell 'A' ($0.5	ext{ V}$) relative to the Daniell cell 'B' ($1.1	ext{ V}$), what net electrochemical reactions proceed across the active terminals of Cell 'B'?
qh: यदि एक युग्मित सेल सिस्टम (coupled cell system) में डेनियल सेल 'B' ($1.1 V$) के सापेक्ष सेल 'A' ($0.5 V$) का कम विरोधी वोल्टेज है, तो सेल 'B' के सक्रिय टर्मिनलों पर क्या नेट इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल प्रतिक्रियाएं आगे बढ़ती हैं?
o: $	ext{Anode: } 	ext{Cu} ightarrow 	ext{Cu}^{2+} + 2e^- ; \, 	ext{Cathode: } 	ext{Zn}^{2+} + 2e^- \rightarrow \text{Zn}$
$	ext{Anode: } 	ext{Zn} \rightarrow \text{Zn}^{2+} + 2e^- ; \, 	ext{Cathode: } \text{Cu}^{2+} + 2e^- \rightarrow \text{Cu}$ (सेल B गैल्वेनिक सेल की तरह सामान्य रूप से कार्य करेगा)
$\text{Anode: } 2\text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{O}_2 + 4\text{H}^+ + 4e^- ; \, \text{Cathode: } \text{Na}^+ + e^- \rightarrow \text{Na}$
$\text{Anode: } \text{PbSO}_4 + 2\text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{PbO}_2 + \text{SO}_4^{2-} + 4\text{H}^+ + 2e^-$
e: Explanation: When the opposing potential from Cell 'A' ($0.5 ext{ V}$) is less than the native potential of the Daniell cell 'B' ($1.1 ext{ V}$), the Daniell cell operates normally as a Galvanic cell. It drives electrons out, maintaining its natural chemistry: zinc undergoes oxidation at the anode, and copper undergoes reduction at the cathode.

qe: When an active Zinc-Silver Galvanic cell begins to operate spontaneously, what is the direction of the electron stream through the external circuit, and why?
qh: जब एक सक्रिय जिंक-सिल्वर गैल्वेनिक सेल स्वतः कार्य करना शुरू करता है, तो बाहरी सर्किट के माध्यम से इलेक्ट्रॉन प्रवाह की दिशा क्या होती है, और क्यों?
o: Electrons flow from silver to zinc because silver has a more negative reduction potential
Electrons flow from zinc to silver because zinc has a more negative standard reduction potential, readily undergoing oxidation at the anode (इलेक्ट्रॉन जिंक से सिल्वर की ओर जाएंगे)
Electrons remain locked within the salt bridge gel matrix channel
Electrons move back and forth rapidly via an alternating current profile
e: Explanation: Zinc features a more negative standard reduction potential ($-0.76 ext{ V}$) than silver ($+0.80 ext{ V}$). This means zinc oxidizes more easily, acting as the anode. Electrons flow from the electron-rich anode (zinc) through the external wire to the cathode (silver).

qe: Which specific electrode domain serves as the functional location for the reduction half-reaction inside a spontaneous Zinc-Silver electrochemical cell?
qh: एक स्वतः जिंक-सिल्वर इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल सेल के भीतर अपचयन हाफ-प्रतिक्रिया (reduction half-reaction) के लिए कौन सा विशिष्ट इलेक्ट्रोड डोमेन कार्यात्मक स्थान के रूप में कार्य करता है?
o: The zinc plate which acts as the negative anode terminal
The silver plate which acts as the positive cathode terminal (सिल्वर प्लेट कैथोड की तरह कार्य करेगी)
The glass boundary layer holding the inert agar-agar gel
The central porous membrane block containing volatile non-polar fluid
e: Explanation: In a spontaneous Zinc-Silver cell system, silver ions ($ ext{Ag}^+$) gain electrons at the surface of the silver plate ($ ext{Ag}^+ + e^- \rightarrow ext{Ag}(s)$). Because reduction occurs at this interface, the silver plate acts as the cathode.

qe: What happens to the operational behavior of an active Galvanic cell if its functional salt bridge component is completely removed from the compartment system?
qh: यदि किसी सक्रिय गैल्वेनिक सेल के कार्यात्मक लवण सेतु (salt bridge) घटक को कम्पार्टमेंट सिस्टम से पूरी तरह से हटा दिया जाए तो उसके परिचालन व्यवहार का क्या होता है?
o: The cell potential climbs exponentially to twice its normal standard voltage
The cell instantly stops functioning because the internal electrical circuit is broken, causing the potential to drop to zero (सेल कार्य करना बंद कर देगा क्योंकि विभव शून्य हो जाता है)
The cell converts into a biodegradable aliphatic polyester storage resin
The active solutions undergo rapid conversion into volatile open-chain methane
e: Explanation: A salt bridge completes the internal electrical circuit of a Galvanic cell and maintains charge neutrality by allowing counter-ions to migrate. Completely removing it breaks the circuit, leading to an immediate charge accumulation that drops the cell potential to zero and halts cell function.

qe: How do the respective chemical concentrations of $\text{Zn}^{2+}$ and $\text{Ag}^+$ ions change over time while a Zinc-Silver cell operates spontaneously?
qh: एक जिंक-सिल्वर सेल के स्वतः कार्य करने के दौरान समय के साथ $\text{Zn}^{2+}$ और $\text{Ag}^+$ आयनों की संबंधित रासायनिक सांद्रता कैसे बदलती है?
o: The concentration of $\text{Zn}^{2+}$ drops linearly while $[\text{Ag}^+]$ increases exponentially
The concentration of $\text{Zn}^{2+}$ increases due to anode dissolution, while the concentration of $\text{Ag}^+$ decreases due to cathode plating (Zn2+ की सांद्रता बढ़ेगी तथा Ag+ की घटेगी)
Both concentrations remain locked at exactly 1 M due to coordination rules
Both ionic concentrations drop to absolute zero via common-ion effects
e: Explanation: As the cell operates spontaneously, metallic zinc undergoes continuous oxidation at the anode ($ ext{Zn} \rightarrow ext{Zn}^{2+} + 2e^-$), which increases $[\text{Zn}^{2+}]$ over time. Simultaneously, silver ions undergo continuous reduction and plate out at the cathode ($\text{Ag}^+ + e^- \rightarrow \text{Ag}$), decreasing $[\text{Ag}^+]$.

qe: Once an electrochemical cell achieves a completely 'dead' status, what can be stated about the variation in ionic concentrations inside the electrolyte compartments?
qh: एक बार जब इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल सेल पूरी तरह से 'डेड' (dead) स्थिति प्राप्त कर लेता है, तो इलेक्ट्रोलाइट डिब्बों के भीतर आयनिक सांद्रता में परिवर्तन के बारे में क्या कहा जा सकता है?
o: The concentrations continue to shift rapidly until the fluid evaporates completely
The system has reached chemical equilibrium, meaning the concentrations of $\text{Zn}^{2+}$ and $\text{Ag}^+$ ions stabilize and no longer change (साम्यावस्था पर सांद्रता स्थिर हो जाती है)
The concentrations drop to zero absolute indicators
The ions combine to form a rigid cross-linked polymer network sheet
e: Explanation: A 'dead' cell has reached a state of thermodynamic chemical equilibrium ($E_{\text{cell}} = 0\text{ V}$). At chemical equilibrium, the forward and reverse reaction rates balance exactly, meaning the chemical concentrations of all participating ions stabilize and remain constant.

qe: What thermodynamic parameter defines the maximum electrical work that can be extracted from a Galvanic cell operating under perfectly reversible conditions?
qh: परफेक्टली प्रतिवर्ती (reversible) परिस्थितियों में काम करने वाले गैल्वेनिक सेल से निकाले जा सकने वाले अधिकतम विद्युत कार्य को कौन सा ऊष्मागतिक पैरामीटर परिभाषित करता है?
o: The total entropy shift calculated across the boundary layer
The decrease in the system's Gibbs Free Energy Change ($-\Delta_r G$) (गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा में कमी)
The linear increase in the internal resistance profile
The total heat capacity value managed under high pressures
e: Explanation: When a Galvanic cell operates reversibly, the electrical work performed is at its theoretical maximum. Thermodynamics dictates that this maximum useful electrical work equals the decrease in the Gibbs Free Energy change of the system: $W_{\text{max}} = -\Delta_r G$.

qe: Why is the Gibbs free energy change ($\Delta_r G$) classified as an extensive thermodynamic property, while the cell potential ($E_{\text{cell}}$) behaves as an intensive property?
qh: गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा परिवर्तन ($\Delta_r G$) को एक विस्तीर्ण ऊष्मागतिक गुण (extensive thermodynamic property) के रूप में क्यों वर्गीकृत किया जाता है, जबकि सेल विभव ($E_{\text{cell}}$) एक गहन गुण (intensive property) की तरह व्यवहार करता है?
o: $\Delta_r G$ is extensive because its energy value scales directly with the stoichiometric number of moles ($n$) reacting, while voltage is independent of scale (\Delta_r G विस्तीर्ण तथा E_cell गहन गुण है)
$\Delta_r G$ depends entirely on the cross-linking density of the methylene bridges
$\Delta_r G$ is extensive because it converts directly into a volatile open-chain non-polar gas
There is no difference; both are intensive parameters driven by temperature loops
e: Explanation: Cell potential ($E_{\text{cell}}$) is an intensive property because voltage represents an electrical potential field that is independent of reaction scale. Conversely, the Gibbs free energy change is extensive because its energy output values depend directly on the number of moles of electrons transferred ($n$) via the relationship $\Delta_r G = -nFE_{\text{cell}}$.

qe: What thermodynamic value is calculated for the standard Gibbs free energy change ($\Delta_r G^\circ$) of a classic Daniell cell reaction when its standard potential is +1.1 V and $n=2$?
qh: एक क्लासिक डेनियल सेल प्रतिक्रिया के मानक गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा परिवर्तन ($\Delta_r G^\circ$) के लिए क्या थर्मोडायनामिक मान प्राप्त होता है जब इसका मानक विभव +1.1 V और $n=2$ हो?
o: $\Delta_r G^\circ = +2.2 \cdot F$
$\Delta_r G^\circ = -2 \cdot F \cdot 1.1 = -2.2\text{ F}$ (गिब्स ऊर्जा परिवर्तन मान)
$\Delta_r G^\circ = \frac{-1.1}{2F}$
$\Delta_r G^\circ = 0\text{ J/mol}$
e: Explanation: Using the standard thermodynamic equation $\Delta_r G^\circ = -nFE^\circ_{\text{cell}}$, we substitute the reaction parameters for a Daniell cell ($n = 2$, $E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = 1.1\text{ V}$). This yields the direct mathematical relationship: $\Delta_r G^\circ = -2 \cdot F \cdot 1.1 = -2.2\text{ F}$ Joules per mole.

qe: Which specific inter-unit connection coordinates the monosaccharide building blocks together inside a high molecular weight polysaccharide like cellulose?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट इंटर-यूनिट कनेक्शन उच्च आणविक भार वाले पॉलीसेकेराइड जैसे सेलुलोज के भीतर मोनोसेकेराइड बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक्स को एक साथ जोड़ता है?
o: Alpha-1,4-peptide bond linkages bridging amino components
Beta-1,4-glycosidic linkage connecting linear glucose units (बीटा-1,4-ग्लाइकोसिडिक बंध)
Phosphodiester coordinate bridges linking pentose sugars
Highly branched cross-link networks typical of starch chains
e: Explanation: Cellulose is an unbranched linear polysaccharide constructed entirely from repeating $\beta$-D-glucose monomers. These subunits are joined together through regular $\beta$-1,4-glycosidic linkages to form strong, straight structural fibers.

qe: What specific operational unit matches the physical measurement designation of specific conductivity ($\kappa$) in standard electrochemical systems?
qh: कौन सी विशिष्ट परिचालन इकाई मानक इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल प्रणालियों में विशिष्ट चालकता ($\kappa$) के भौतिक माप पदनाम से मेल खाती है?
o: $\text{S}\cdot\text{cm}^2\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}$
$\text{S}\cdot\text{cm}^{-1}$ or $\text{S}\cdot\text{m}^{-1}$ (विशिष्ट चालकता की इकाई)
Volt ($\text{V}$)
e: Explanation: Specific conductivity ($\kappa$) measures current-carrying capacity per unit volume, which corresponds to the reciprocal of resistivity ($1/\rho$). Its systematic measurement units are expressed as $\text{S}\cdot\text{cm}^{-1}$ or $\text{S}\cdot\text{m}^{-1}$.

qe: What physical parameter dictates why the limiting molar conductivity of a strong electrolyte like sodium acetate expands only gradually upon progressive dilution?
qh: कौन सा भौतिक पैरामीटर यह निर्देशित करता है कि सोडियम एसीटेट जैसे मजबूत इलेक्ट्रोलाइट की सीमित मोलर चालकता प्रगतिशील तनुकरण करने पर केवल धीरे-धीरे क्यों बढ़ती है?
o: The compound undergoes complete structural degradation into volatile chlorine segments
The strong electrolyte is already fully ionized, and dilution merely increases ion spacing to reduce inter-ionic attractions (केवल अंतर-आयनिक आकर्षण का कम होना)
The solution enters an intricate non-ionic furanose sugar matrix loop
The treatment converts the sodium ions into narrow-spectrum antibiotics
e: Explanation: Strong electrolytes are completely dissociated into ions even at standard working concentrations. Diluting the solution does not increase the number of ions; it simply expands the volume, increasing the distance between ions and reducing inter-ionic friction, which results in a gradual, modest increase in $\Lambda_m$.

qe: What algebraic expression balances the limiting molar conductivity of an electrolyte to the individual values of its constituent ions under Kohlrausch's law?
qh: कोलराउश के नियम के तहत कौन सा बीजगणितीय व्यंजक (algebraic expression) किसी इलेक्ट्रोलाइट की सीमित मोलर चालकता को उसके घटक आयनों के व्यक्तिगत मानों से संतुलित करता है?
o: It represents the direct product of the separate coordinate potential barriers
It equals the sum of the individual limiting ionic conductivities of its constituent cations and anions (आयनिक चालकताओं का योग)
It matches the inverse of the logarithmic equilibrium constant value
It represents the total mass of metal deposited per Faradaic second
e: Explanation: Kohlrausch's law of independent ion migration states that at infinite dilution, all inter-ionic forces disappear. Each ion contributes a fixed amount to the total conductance, meaning the limiting molar conductivity of an electrolyte equals the sum of the individual conductivities of its constituent cations and anions.

qe: Which specific category of synthetic materials handles the direct conversion of the chemical energy generated from burning hydrogen and oxygen fuels into an electrical current?
qh: सिंथेटिक सामग्रियों की कौन सी विशिष्ट श्रेणी हाइड्रोजन और ऑक्सीजन ईंधन को जलाने से उत्पन्न रासायनिक ऊर्जा को सीधे विद्युत प्रवाह में बदलने का काम करती है?
o: Primary dry cell blocks containing limited zinc reactants
Fuel cells (ईंधन सेल)
Nickel-Cadmium rechargeable structural batteries
Mercury button batteries engineered for hearing aids
e: Explanation: Hydrogen-oxygen fuel cells are specialized galvanic systems designed to continuously transform the chemical energy of a fuel combustion reaction ($2\text{H}_2 + \text{O}_2 \rightarrow 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$) directly into electrical energy, operating with high efficiency as long as reactants are supplied.

qe: What specific architectural feature differentiates a synthetic thermoplastic material from a standard thermosetting plastic resin?
qh: कौन सी विशिष्ट संरचनात्मक विशेषता एक सिंथेटिक थर्मोप्लास्टिक सामग्री को एक मानक थर्मोसेटिंग प्लास्टिक राल से अलग करती है?
o: Thermoplastics contain a dense network of permanent cross-links that resist melting
Thermoplastics are composed of linear or slightly branched long chains that lack permanent cross-links, enabling reversible thermal softening and hardening (क्रॉस-लिंक्स का अभाव)
Thermoplastics completely lack carbon atoms inside their organic skeletons
Thermoplastics undergo spontaneous conversion into water-soluble linear starch
e: Explanation: Thermoplastics consist of linear or slightly branched chains held together by intermediate intermolecular forces. Because they lack permanent covalent cross-links between individual strands, heating fluidizes the structure reversibly, allowing for remolding and recycling.

qe: Which structural feature characterises the alpha-helix secondary structure of a protein, keeping the right-handed screw shape stable?
qh: कौन सी संरचनात्मक विशेषता एक प्रोटीन की अल्फा-हेलिक्स माध्यमिक संरचना की विशेषता है, जो दाहिने हाथ की पेंच जैसी आकृति को स्थिर रखती है?
o: Weak van der Waals forces acting uniformly across non-polar branches
Intramolecular hydrogen bonds formed between the N-H group of an amino acid residue and the carbonyl C=O group of an adjacent turn (N-H और C=O के बीच हाइड्रोजन बंध)
Reversible ester links that undergo rapid reduction with basic catalysts
Cationic quaternary nitrogen halide cross-linked coordination zones
e: Explanation: The helical conformation of an $\alpha$-helix is locked and stabilized by regular hydrogen bonds. These form between the polar amide $N-H$ group located along one turn of the coiled backbone and the carbonyl $C=O$ group belonging to the adjacent loop.

qe: What direct mechanical consequence occurs when an active biological protein structure undergoes denaturation under intense thermal stress?
qh: जब एक सक्रिय जैविक प्रोटीन संरचना तीव्र थर्मल तनाव के तहत विकृतीकरण (denaturation) से गुजरती है तो क्या सीधा यांत्रिक परिणाम होता है?
o: The covalent peptide bonds are completely cleaved, reducing the protein to single units
The higher-order secondary and tertiary structural folds unfold and disrupt, causing total loss of biological activity (2° एवं 3° संरचना का खुलना या नष्ट होना)
The carbon framework instantly converts into a volatile open-chain non-polar gas
The embedded strands form a permanent three-dimensional network typical of Bakelite
e: Explanation: Denaturation breaks down the secondary, tertiary, and quaternary folds of a native protein by disrupting non-covalent interactions (like hydrogen bonds and salt bridges) under physical or chemical stress, destroying its biological function while leaving the primary sequence intact.

qe: Which organizational level of protein structure remains completely unaltered and structurally intact during a standard chemical denaturation run?
qh: एक मानक रासायनिक विकृतीकरण (chemical denaturation) के दौरान प्रोटीन संरचना का कौन सा संगठनात्मक स्तर पूरी तरह से अपरिवर्तित और संरचनात्मक रूप से बरकरार रहता है?
o: The global tertiary folding network
The primary structure comprising the continuous sequence of amino acids (प्राथमिक संरचना सुरक्षित रहती है)
The crystalline alpha-helix hydrogen-bonded conformation
The multi-subunit quaternary orientation layout
e: Explanation: While denaturation disrupts higher-order folding patterns (secondary, tertiary, and quaternary structures) due to the sensitivity of non-covalent forces, it does not cleave the covalent peptide bonds of the primary backbone, leaving the amino acid sequence intact.

qe: Why can a prolonged deficiency of calciferol (Vitamin D) inside human operational frameworks cause serious bone weaknesses or rickets in developing children?
qh: मानव शरीर के भीतर कैल्सीफेरोल (विटामिन डी) की लंबे समय तक कमी विकासशील बच्चों में गंभीर हड्डी की कमजोरियों या रिकेट्स का कारण क्यों बन सकती है?
o: It converts the skeleton into a water-soluble linear carbohydrate mesh
It disrupts normal calcium absorption pathways, preventing proper mineralization and hardening of structural bones (कैल्शियम अवशोषण बाधित होना)
It causes the continuous fuming of volatile nitric acid from tissue layers
It limits the free-radical polymerization of alkenes throughout the body
e: Explanation: Vitamin D (calciferol) is essential for regulating and optimizing calcium absorption from the gastrointestinal tract. A deficiency prevents proper calcium deposition, leaving structural bone matrices soft and weak, which leads to conditions like rickets in children.

qe: Why does the industrial electrolysis of a concentrated brine solution ($	ext{NaCl}$) favor the release of chlorine gas ($Cl_2$) at the anode over oxygen gas ($O_2$), despite water having a lower standard potential requirement?
qh: सांद्र नमक के घोल ($	ext{NaCl}$) का औद्योगिक विद्युत अपघटन (electrolysis) पानी की तुलना में एनोड पर क्लोरीन गैस ($Cl_2$) के निकलने को क्यों प्राथमिकता देता है, जबकि पानी का मानक विभव कम होता है?
o: Because chlorine atoms are completely insoluble in aqueous mediums
Because water oxidation is kinetically sluggish and requires a substantial overpotential value to proceed (ऑक्सीजन निर्माण के लिए ओवर-पोटेंशियल की आवश्यकता)
Because the reaction triggers immediate common-ion precipitation of all materials
Because it causes the spontaneous degradation of the matching salt bridge gel
e: Explanation: Thermodynamically, water oxidation requires less potential ($1.23 ext{ V}$) than chloride oxidation ($1.36 ext{ V}$). However, the kinetics of oxygen evolution are highly sluggish, creating a structural voltage barrier known as overpotential or overvoltage. This suppresses water breakdown, causing chloride ions to selectively oxidize into chlorine gas.

qe: Why must an alternating current (AC) power source be deliberately utilized when measuring the electrical resistance of an ionic solution?
qh: एक आयनिक विलयन के विद्युत प्रतिरोध को मापते समय अल्टरनेटिंग करंट (AC) पावर स्रोत का जानबूझकर उपयोग क्यों किया जाना चाहिए?
o: To accelerate the common-ion precipitation of volatile metal halides
To keep the ion concentration uniform and prevent polarization errors that occur with a DC source (सांद्रता को स्थिर रखना तथा ध्रुवण रोकना)
To convert the solution into an unbranched biodegradable polyester network
To lower the activation energy of the water solvent matrix
e: Explanation: Using a direct current (DC) source drives continuous electrolysis, which rapidly alters the local chemical concentration of ions near the electrode surfaces and polarizes the cell. An alternating current (AC) source constantly reverses direction, keeping the solution composition uniform and stable for accurate resistance profiling.

qe: What physical parameter status marks the exact boundary condition where electrical current stops flowing through an active Galvanic cell circuit?
qh: कौन सी भौतिक पैरामीटर स्थिति उस सटीक सीमा स्थिति को चिह्नित करती है जहां एक सक्रिय गैल्वेनिक सेल सर्किट के माध्यम से विद्युत धारा का प्रवाह रुक जाता है?
o: The standard cell potential ($E^\circ_{	ext{cell}}$) drops precisely to zero volts
The dynamic cell potential ($E_{	ext{cell}}$) drops to exactly zero volts as chemical equilibrium is reached ($E_{cell} = 0$ होने पर साम्यावस्था स्थापित होना)
The resistance of the salt bridge matrix climbs to absolute infinity
The total entropy of the surrounding buffer drops to zero
e: Explanation: As a Galvanic cell operates, the reacting species continuously shift toward a state of chemical equilibrium. Once absolute chemical equilibrium is achieved, the overall cell potential ($E_{ ext{cell}}$) drops to exactly $0 ext{ V}$, meaning no net potential difference exists to drive an electron stream, halting the current flow.

qe: The Nernst equation for a silver half-cell is expressed as $E = E^\circ + 0.0591\log[\text{Ag}^+]$. Based on this mathematical relationship, how does the reduction potential react if the silver ion concentration is systematically expanded?
qh: सिल्वर हाफ-सेल के लिए नर्स्ट समीकरण $E = E^\circ + 0.0591\log[\text{Ag}^+]$ है। इस गणितीय संबंध के आधार पर, यदि सिल्वर आयन सांद्रता को व्यवस्थित रूप से बढ़ाया जाए तो अपचयन विभव (reduction potential) कैसे प्रतिक्रिया करता है?
o: The potential decreases linearly because of volume constraints
The potential increases directly because it is positively proportional to the logarithm of silver ion concentration (सिल्वर आयन सांद्रता बढ़ने पर विभव का बढ़ना)
The potential drops instantly to zero absolute volts
The potential switches signs from positive to negative values
e: Explanation: The Nernst equation for the silver couple ($E_{ ext{Ag}^+/ ext{Ag}} = E^\circ_{ ext{Ag}^+/ ext{Ag}} + 0.0591\log[ ext{Ag}^+]$) shows a directly proportional relationship between the dynamic potential and the logarithm of the silver ion concentration. Consequently, raising $[\text{Ag}^+]$ expands the logarithmic term, systematically increasing the electrode potential value.

qe: Why can an aqueous copper sulfate solution ($\text{CuSO}_4$) absolutely not be safely stored inside a container fabricated from solid zinc metal sheets?
qh: कॉपर सल्फेट ($\text{CuSO}_4$) के जलीय विलयन को ठोस जिंक धातु की चादरों से बने कंटेनर के भीतर सुरक्षित रूप से क्यों नहीं रखा जा सकता है?
o: Because copper sulfate evaporates into volatile sulfur dioxide gas upon contact with zinc
Because zinc possesses a negative standard reduction potential making it more reactive than copper, leading to a spontaneous displacement reaction (जिंक कॉपर से अधिक क्रियाशील है)
Because zinc forms an intricate non-ionic furanose sugar matrix with the solution
Because the setup initiates immediate structural denaturation of the container wall amides
e: Explanation: Zinc has a negative standard reduction potential ($-0.76 ext{ V}$) compared to copper ($+0.34 ext{ V}$), meaning it is more reactive and oxidizes more easily. Storing $ ext{CuSO}_4$ in a zinc vessel triggers a spontaneous single-displacement reaction where zinc dissolves into the solution as $ ext{Zn}^{2+}$ and copper plates out, destroying the container.

qe: Consider a setup where two cells are coupled together: Cell 'A' is an electrochemical cell with an EMF of 2.0 V, and Cell 'B' is a Daniell cell with a potential of 1.1 V. Which cell will be forced to operate as an electrolytic cell, and what reaction occurs at its anode?
qh: एक सेटअप पर विचार करें जहां दो सेलों को एक साथ जोड़ा गया है: सेल 'A' 2.0 V के EMF वाला एक इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल सेल है, और सेल 'B' 1.1 V के विभव वाला एक डेनियल सेल है। कौन सा सेल इलेक्ट्रोलाइटिक सेल के रूप में कार्य करने के लिए मजबूर होगा, और इसके एनोड पर क्या प्रतिक्रिया होगी?
o: Cell A; Zinc undergoes rapid reduction to metallic sheets
Cell B; Copper metal undergoes oxidation to dissolve as $\text{Cu}^{2+}$ ions (सेल B इलेक्ट्रोलाइटिक सेल की तरह कार्य करेगा तथा कॉपर का ऑक्सीकरण होगा)
Cell A; Liquid water splits into volatile open-chain non-polar gases
Cell B; Sulfate ions are converted into linear Novolac strings
e: Explanation: Because Cell 'A' delivers a higher opposing voltage ($2.0 ext{ V}$) than the native potential of the Daniell cell 'B' ($1.1 ext{ V}$), it drives current backward through Cell 'B'. This forces Cell 'B' to function as an electrolytic cell, reversing its natural half-reactions so that copper metal undergoes oxidation at the anode: $ ext{Cu}(s) ightarrow ext{Cu}^{2+} + 2e^-$.

qe: If a coupled cell system features a lower opposing voltage from Cell 'A' ($0.5	ext{ V}$) relative to the Daniell cell 'B' ($1.1	ext{ V}$), what net electrochemical reactions proceed across the active terminals of Cell 'B'?
qh: यदि एक युग्मित सेल सिस्टम (coupled cell system) में डेनियल सेल 'B' ($1.1 V$) के सापेक्ष सेल 'A' ($0.5 V$) का कम विरोधी वोल्टेज है, तो सेल 'B' के सक्रिय टर्मिनलों पर क्या नेट इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल प्रतिक्रियाएं आगे बढ़ती हैं?
o: $	ext{Anode: } 	ext{Cu} \rightarrow \text{Cu}^{2+} + 2e^- ; \, 	ext{Cathode: } 	ext{Zn}^{2+} + 2e^- \rightarrow 	ext{Zn}$
$	ext{Anode: } 	ext{Zn} \rightarrow \text{Zn}^{2+} + 2e^- ; \, 	ext{Cathode: } \text{Cu}^{2+} + 2e^- \rightarrow \text{Cu}$ (सेल B गैल्वेनिक सेल की तरह सामान्य रूप से कार्य करेगा)
$\text{Anode: } 2\text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{O}_2 + 4\text{H}^+ + 4e^- ; \, \text{Cathode: } \text{Na}^+ + e^- \rightarrow \text{Na}$
$\text{Anode: } \text{PbSO}_4 + 2\text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{PbO}_2 + \text{SO}_4^{2-} + 4\text{H}^+ + 2e^-$
e: Explanation: When the opposing potential from Cell 'A' ($0.5 ext{ V}$) is less than the native potential of the Daniell cell 'B' ($1.1 ext{ V}$), the Daniell cell operates normally as a Galvanic cell. It drives electrons out, maintaining its natural chemistry: zinc undergoes oxidation at the anode, and copper undergoes reduction at the cathode.

qe: When an active Zinc-Silver Galvanic cell begins to operate spontaneously, what is the direction of the electron stream through the external circuit, and why?
qh: जब एक सक्रिय जिंक-सिल्वर गैल्वेनिक सेल स्वतः कार्य करना शुरू करता है, तो बाहरी सर्किट के माध्यम से इलेक्ट्रॉन प्रवाह की दिशा क्या होती है, और क्यों?
o: Electrons flow from silver to zinc because silver has a more negative reduction potential
Electrons flow from zinc to silver because zinc has a more negative standard reduction potential, readily undergoing oxidation at the anode (इलेक्ट्रॉन जिंक से सिल्वर की ओर जाएंगे)
Electrons remain locked within the salt bridge gel matrix channel
Electrons move back and forth rapidly via an alternating current profile
e: Explanation: Zinc features a more negative standard reduction potential ($-0.76 ext{ V}$) than silver ($+0.80 ext{ V}$). This means zinc oxidizes more easily, acting as the anode. Electrons flow from the electron-rich anode (zinc) through the external wire to the cathode (silver).

qe: Which specific electrode domain serves as the functional location for the reduction half-reaction inside a spontaneous Zinc-Silver electrochemical cell?
qh: एक स्वतः जिंक-सिल्वर इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल सेल के भीतर अपचयन हाफ-प्रतिक्रिया (reduction half-reaction) के लिए कौन सा विशिष्ट इलेक्ट्रोड डोमेन कार्यात्मक स्थान के रूप में कार्य करता है?
o: The zinc plate which acts as the negative anode terminal
The silver plate which acts as the positive cathode terminal (सिल्वर प्लेट कैथोड की तरह कार्य करेगी)
The glass boundary layer holding the inert agar-agar gel
The central porous membrane block containing volatile non-polar fluid
e: Explanation: In a spontaneous Zinc-Silver cell system, silver ions ($ ext{Ag}^+$) gain electrons at the surface of the silver plate ($ ext{Ag}^+ + e^- \rightarrow ext{Ag}(s)$). Because reduction occurs at this interface, the silver plate acts as the cathode.

qe: What happens to the operational behavior of an active Galvanic cell if its functional salt bridge component is completely removed from the compartment system?
qh: यदि किसी सक्रिय गैल्वेनिक सेल के कार्यात्मक लवण सेतु (salt bridge) घटक को कम्पार्टमेंट सिस्टम से पूरी तरह से हटा दिया जाए तो उसके परिचालन व्यवहार का क्या होता है?
o: The cell potential climbs exponentially to twice its normal standard voltage
The cell instantly stops functioning because the internal electrical circuit is broken, causing the potential to drop to zero (सेल कार्य करना बंद कर देगा क्योंकि विभव शून्य हो जाता है)
The cell converts into a biodegradable aliphatic polyester storage resin
The active solutions undergo rapid conversion into volatile open-chain methane
e: Explanation: A salt bridge completes the internal electrical circuit of a Galvanic cell and maintains charge neutrality by allowing counter-ions to migrate. Completely removing it breaks the circuit, leading to an immediate charge accumulation that drops the cell potential to zero and halts cell function.

qe: How do the respective chemical concentrations of $\text{Zn}^{2+}$ and $\text{Ag}^+$ ions change over time while a Zinc-Silver cell operates spontaneously?
qh: एक जिंक-सिल्वर सेल के स्वतः कार्य करने के दौरान समय के साथ $\text{Zn}^{2+}$ और $\text{Ag}^+$ आयनों की संबंधित रासायनिक सांद्रता कैसे बदलती है?
o: The concentration of $\text{Zn}^{2+}$ drops linearly while $[\text{Ag}^+]$ increases exponentially
The concentration of $\text{Zn}^{2+}$ increases due to anode dissolution, while the concentration of $\text{Ag}^+$ decreases due to cathode plating (Zn2+ की सांद्रता बढ़ेगी तथा Ag+ की घटेगी)
Both concentrations remain locked at exactly 1 M due to coordination rules
Both ionic concentrations drop to absolute zero via common-ion effects
e: Explanation: As the cell operates spontaneously, metallic zinc undergoes continuous oxidation at the anode ($ ext{Zn} \rightarrow ext{Zn}^{2+} + 2e^-$), which increases $[\text{Zn}^{2+}]$ over time. Simultaneously, silver ions undergo continuous reduction and plate out at the cathode ($\text{Ag}^+ + e^- \rightarrow \text{Ag}$), decreasing $[\text{Ag}^+]$.

qe: Once an electrochemical cell achieves a completely 'dead' status, what can be stated about the variation in ionic concentrations inside the electrolyte compartments?
qh: एक बार जब इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल सेल पूरी तरह से 'डेड' (dead) स्थिति प्राप्त कर लेता है, तो इलेक्ट्रोलाइट डिब्बों के भीतर आयनिक सांद्रता में परिवर्तन के बारे में क्या कहा जा सकता है?
o: The concentrations continue to shift rapidly until the fluid evaporates completely
The system has reached chemical equilibrium, meaning the concentrations of $\text{Zn}^{2+}$ and $\text{Ag}^+$ ions stabilize and no longer change (साम्यावस्था पर सांद्रता स्थिर हो जाती है)
The concentrations drop to zero absolute indicators
The ions combine to form a rigid cross-linked polymer network sheet
e: Explanation: A 'dead' cell has reached a state of thermodynamic chemical equilibrium ($E_{\text{cell}} = 0\text{ V}$). At chemical equilibrium, the forward and reverse reaction rates balance exactly, meaning the chemical concentrations of all participating ions stabilize and remain constant.

qe: What thermodynamic parameter defines the maximum electrical work that can be extracted from a Galvanic cell operating under perfectly reversible conditions?
qh: परफेक्टली प्रतिवर्ती (reversible) परिस्थितियों में काम करने वाले गैल्वेनिक सेल से निकाले जा सकने वाले अधिकतम विद्युत कार्य को कौन सा ऊष्मागतिक पैरामीटर परिभाषित करता है?
o: The total entropy shift calculated across the boundary layer
The decrease in the system's Gibbs Free Energy Change ($-\Delta_r G$) (गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा में कमी)
The linear increase in the internal resistance profile
The total heat capacity value managed under high pressures
e: Explanation: When a Galvanic cell operates reversibly, the electrical work performed is at its theoretical maximum. Thermodynamics dictates that this maximum useful electrical work equals the decrease in the Gibbs Free Energy change of the system: $W_{\text{max}} = -\Delta_r G$.

qe: Why is the Gibbs free energy change ($\Delta_r G$) classified as an extensive thermodynamic property, while the cell potential ($E_{\text{cell}}$) behaves as an intensive property?
