qh: गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा परिवर्तन ($\Delta_r G$) को एक विस्तीर्ण ऊष्मागतिक गुण (extensive thermodynamic property) के रूप में क्यों वर्गीकृत किया जाता है, जबकि सेल विभव ($E_{\text{cell}}$) एक गहन गुण (intensive property) की तरह व्यवहार करता है?
o: $\Delta_r G$ is extensive because its energy value scales directly with the stoichiometric number of moles ($n$) reacting, while voltage is independent of scale (\Delta_r G विस्तीर्ण तथा E_cell गहन गुण है)
$\Delta_r G$ depends entirely on the cross-linking density of the methylene bridges
$\Delta_r G$ is extensive because it converts directly into a volatile open-chain non-polar gas
There is no difference; both are intensive parameters driven by temperature loops
e: Explanation: Cell potential ($E_{\text{cell}}$) is an intensive property because voltage represents an electrical potential field that is independent of reaction scale. Conversely, the Gibbs free energy change is extensive because its energy output values depend directly on the number of moles of electrons transferred ($n$) via the relationship $\Delta_r G = -nFE_{\text{cell}}$.

qe: What thermodynamic value is calculated for the standard Gibbs free energy change ($\Delta_r G^\circ$) of a classic Daniell cell reaction when its standard potential is +1.1 V and $n=2$?
qh: एक क्लासिक डेनियल सेल प्रतिक्रिया के मानक गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा परिवर्तन ($\Delta_r G^\circ$) के लिए क्या थर्मोडायनामिक मान प्राप्त होता है जब इसका मानक विभव +1.1 V और $n=2$ हो?
o: $\Delta_r G^\circ = +2.2 \cdot F$
$\Delta_r G^\circ = -2 \cdot F \cdot 1.1 = -2.2\text{ F}$ (गिब्स ऊर्जा परिवर्तन मान)
$\Delta_r G^\circ = \frac{-1.1}{2F}$
$\Delta_r G^\circ = 0\text{ J/mol}$
e: Explanation: Using the standard thermodynamic equation $\Delta_r G^\circ = -nFE^\circ_{\text{cell}}$, we substitute the reaction parameters for a Daniell cell ($n = 2$, $E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = 1.1\text{ V}$). This yields the direct mathematical relationship: $\Delta_r G^\circ = -2 \cdot F \cdot 1.1 = -2.2\text{ F}$ Joules per mole.

qe: Which specific inter-unit connection coordinates the monosaccharide building blocks together inside a high molecular weight polysaccharide like cellulose?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट इंटर-यूनिट कनेक्शन उच्च आणविक भार वाले पॉलीसेकेराइड जैसे सेलुलोज के भीतर मोनोसेकेराइड बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक्स को एक साथ जोड़ता है?
o: Alpha-1,4-peptide bond linkages bridging amino components
Beta-1,4-glycosidic linkage connecting linear glucose units (बीटा-1,4-ग्लाइकोसिडिक बंध)
Phosphodiester coordinate bridges linking pentose sugars
Highly branched cross-link networks typical of starch chains
e: Explanation: Cellulose is an unbranched linear polysaccharide constructed entirely from repeating $\beta$-D-glucose monomers. These subunits are joined together through regular $\beta$-1,4-glycosidic linkages to form strong, straight structural fibers.

qe: What specific operational unit matches the physical measurement designation of specific conductivity ($\kappa$) in standard electrochemical systems?
qh: कौन सी विशिष्ट परिचालन इकाई मानक इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल प्रणालियों में विशिष्ट चालकता ($\kappa$) के भौतिक माप पदनाम से मेल खाती है?
o: $\text{S}\cdot\text{cm}^2\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}$
$\text{S}\cdot\text{cm}^{-1}$ or $\text{S}\cdot\text{m}^{-1}$ (विशिष्ट चालकता की इकाई)
Volt ($\text{V}$)
e: Explanation: Specific conductivity ($\kappa$) measures current-carrying capacity per unit volume, which corresponds to the reciprocal of resistivity ($1/\rho$). Its systematic measurement units are expressed as $\text{S}\cdot\text{cm}^{-1}$ or $\text{S}\cdot\text{m}^{-1}$.

qe: What physical parameter dictates why the limiting molar conductivity of a strong electrolyte like sodium acetate expands only gradually upon progressive dilution?
qh: कौन सा भौतिक पैरामीटर यह निर्देशित करता है कि सोडियम एसीटेट जैसे मजबूत इलेक्ट्रोलाइट की सीमित मोलर चालकता प्रगतिशील तनुकरण करने पर केवल धीरे-धीरे क्यों बढ़ती है?
o: The compound undergoes complete structural degradation into volatile chlorine segments
The strong electrolyte is already fully ionized, and dilution merely increases ion spacing to reduce inter-ionic attractions (केवल अंतर-आयनिक आकर्षण का कम होना)
The solution enters an intricate non-ionic furanose sugar matrix loop
The treatment converts the sodium ions into narrow-spectrum antibiotics
e: Explanation: Strong electrolytes are completely dissociated into ions even at standard working concentrations. Diluting the solution does not increase the number of ions; it simply expands the volume, increasing the distance between ions and reducing inter-ionic friction, which results in a gradual, modest increase in $\Lambda_m$.

qe: What algebraic expression balances the limiting molar conductivity of an electrolyte to the individual values of its constituent ions under Kohlrausch's law?
qh: कोलराउश के नियम के तहत कौन सा बीजगणितीय व्यंजक (algebraic expression) किसी इलेक्ट्रोलाइट की सीमित मोलर चालकता को उसके घटक आयनों के व्यक्तिगत मानों से संतुलित करता है?
o: It represents the direct product of the separate coordinate potential barriers
It equals the sum of the individual limiting ionic conductivities of its constituent cations and anions (आयनिक चालकताओं का योग)
It matches the inverse of the logarithmic equilibrium constant value
It represents the total mass of metal deposited per Faradaic second
e: Explanation: Kohlrausch's law of independent ion migration states that at infinite dilution, all inter-ionic forces disappear. Each ion contributes a fixed amount to the total conductance, meaning the limiting molar conductivity of an electrolyte equals the sum of the individual conductivities of its constituent cations and anions.

qe: Which specific category of synthetic materials handles the direct conversion of the chemical energy generated from burning hydrogen and oxygen fuels into an electrical current?
qh: सिंथेटिक सामग्रियों की कौन सी विशिष्ट श्रेणी हाइड्रोजन और ऑक्सीजन ईंधन को जलाने से उत्पन्न रासायनिक ऊर्जा को सीधे विद्युत प्रवाह में बदलने का काम करती है?
o: Primary dry cell blocks containing limited zinc reactants
Fuel cells (ईंधन सेल)
Nickel-Cadmium rechargeable structural batteries
Mercury button batteries engineered for hearing aids
e: Explanation: Hydrogen-oxygen fuel cells are specialized galvanic systems designed to continuously transform the chemical energy of a fuel combustion reaction ($2\text{H}_2 + \text{O}_2 \rightarrow 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$) directly into electrical energy, operating with high efficiency as long as reactants are supplied.

qe: What specific architectural feature differentiates a synthetic thermoplastic material from a standard thermosetting plastic resin?
qh: कौन सी विशिष्ट संरचनात्मक विशेषता एक सिंथेटिक थर्मोप्लास्टिक सामग्री को एक मानक थर्मोसेटिंग प्लास्टिक राल से अलग करती है?
o: Thermoplastics contain a dense network of permanent cross-links that resist melting
Thermoplastics are composed of linear or slightly branched long chains that lack permanent cross-links, enabling reversible thermal softening and hardening (क्रॉस-लिंक्स का अभाव)
Thermoplastics completely lack carbon atoms inside their organic skeletons
Thermoplastics undergo spontaneous conversion into water-soluble linear starch
e: Explanation: Thermoplastics consist of linear or slightly branched chains held together by intermediate intermolecular forces. Because they lack permanent covalent cross-links between individual strands, heating fluidizes the structure reversibly, allowing for remolding and recycling.

qe: Which structural feature characterises the alpha-helix secondary structure of a protein, keeping the right-handed screw shape stable?
qh: कौन सी संरचनात्मक विशेषता एक प्रोटीन की अल्फा-हेलिक्स माध्यमिक संरचना की विशेषता है, जो दाहिने हाथ की पेंच जैसी आकृति को स्थिर रखती है?
o: Weak van der Waals forces acting uniformly across non-polar branches
Intramolecular hydrogen bonds formed between the N-H group of an amino acid residue and the carbonyl C=O group of an adjacent turn (N-H और C=O के बीच हाइड्रोजन बंध)
Reversible ester links that undergo rapid reduction with basic catalysts
Cationic quaternary nitrogen halide cross-linked coordination zones
e: Explanation: The helical conformation of an $\alpha$-helix is locked and stabilized by regular hydrogen bonds. These form between the polar amide $N-H$ group located along one turn of the coiled backbone and the carbonyl $C=O$ group belonging to the adjacent loop.

qe: What direct mechanical consequence occurs when an active biological protein structure undergoes denaturation under intense thermal stress?
qh: जब एक सक्रिय जैविक प्रोटीन संरचना तीव्र थर्मल तनाव के तहत विकृतीकरण (denaturation) से गुजरती है तो क्या सीधा यांत्रिक परिणाम होता है?
o: The covalent peptide bonds are completely cleaved, reducing the protein to single units
The higher-order secondary and tertiary structural folds unfold and disrupt, causing total loss of biological activity (2° एवं 3° संरचना का खुलना या नष्ट होना)
The carbon framework instantly converts into a volatile open-chain non-polar gas
The embedded strands form a permanent three-dimensional network typical of Bakelite
e: Explanation: Denaturation breaks down the secondary, tertiary, and quaternary folds of a native protein by disrupting non-covalent interactions (like hydrogen bonds and salt bridges) under physical or chemical stress, destroying its biological function while leaving the primary sequence intact.

qe: Which organizational level of protein structure remains completely unaltered and structurally intact during a standard chemical denaturation run?
qh: एक मानक रासायनिक विकृतीकरण (chemical denaturation) के दौरान प्रोटीन संरचना का कौन सा संगठनात्मक स्तर पूरी तरह से अपरिवर्तित और संरचनात्मक रूप से बरकरार रहता है?
o: The global tertiary folding network
The primary structure comprising the continuous sequence of amino acids (प्राथमिक संरचना सुरक्षित रहती है)
The crystalline alpha-helix hydrogen-bonded conformation
The multi-subunit quaternary orientation layout
e: Explanation: While denaturation disrupts higher-order folding patterns (secondary, tertiary, and quaternary structures) due to the sensitivity of non-covalent forces, it does not cleave the covalent peptide bonds of the primary backbone, leaving the amino acid sequence intact.

qe: Why can a prolonged deficiency of calciferol (Vitamin D) inside human operational frameworks cause serious bone weaknesses or rickets in developing children?
qh: मानव शरीर के भीतर कैल्सीफेरोल (विटामिन डी) की लंबे समय तक कमी विकासशील बच्चों में गंभीर हड्डी की कमजोरियों या रिकेट्स का कारण क्यों बन सकती है?
o: It converts the skeleton into a water-soluble linear carbohydrate mesh
It disrupts normal calcium absorption pathways, preventing proper mineralization and hardening of structural bones (कैल्शियम अवशोषण बाधित होना)
It causes the continuous fuming of volatile nitric acid from tissue layers
It limits the free-radical polymerization of alkenes throughout the body
e: Explanation: Vitamin D (calciferol) is essential for regulating and optimizing calcium absorption from the gastrointestinal tract. A deficiency prevents proper calcium deposition, leaving structural bone matrices soft and weak, which leads to conditions like rickets in children.
